sa: ततः शरशतेनैव सुप्रयुक्तेन वीर्यवान्। क्रोधाद् द्विगुणसंरब्धो निर्बिभेद विभीषणम्॥
en: Then, fired with double fury, that powerful one pierced Vibhīşana with an hundred arrows, powerfully discharged (from his weapons.)

sa: यावदावर्तते चक्रं यावती च वसुंधरा। तावत्त्वमिह लोकस्य स्वामित्वमनुवर्तय॥
en: Do you govern the people as long as the solar system exists and as far as the earth extends.

sa: शक्यं यदि मया श्रोतुं न खल्वाज्ञापयामि वः। यदि गुह्यं न चेद्वक्तुं श्रोतुमिच्छामि कथ्यताम्॥
en: If I can well hear the same (do you tell it me). I by no means command you. If the thing can bear disclosure, I would hear it. Pray, speak out.

sa: तस्य तत्कर्म विज्ञाय तदा वैश्रवणात्मजः॥ मुहूर्तात्क्रोधताम्राक्षस्तोयं जग्राह पाणिना।
en: Having ascertained the truth within a moment Vaisravana's son, with eyes reddened with ire, took water in his palms.

sa: अमरा ऋषयश्चैव संगम्य किल शंकरम्। अस्मद्वधं परीप्सन्त इदं वचनमब्रुवन्॥ सुकेशतनया देव वरदनाबलोद्धताः। बाधन्तेऽस्मान्समुद्रुप्ता घोररूपाः पदे पदे॥
en: The immortals and sages, going to Sankara, spoke these words, desirous of our destruction, The terrific sons of Sukeśa, puffed up, and swollen on account of their strength flowing from the boon, are crossing us at every step.

sa: प्रगृहीता बभौ तेषां वस्त्राणामावलिः शिवा ॥ शरदभ्रप्रतीकाशा हंसावलिरिवाम्बरे।
en: The various gorgeous attires which they had worn resembled rows of cranes in the sky, looking like autumnal clouds.

sa: केनोपायेन पश्येयं मैथिली जनकात्मजाम्। अदृष्टो राक्षसेन्द्रेण रावणेन दुरात्मना॥
en: How can I, without being discovered by the impious lord of Rākşasas, Rāvana, succeed in seeing Janaka's daughter, Maithili?

sa: शीघ्रं वरय धर्मज्ञ वरो यस्तेऽभिकाङ्कितः। कं ते कामं करोम्यद्य न वृथा ते परिश्रमः॥
en: Do you, O cognisant of righteousness, at once ask for the boon that you wish to have. What wish of your shall I realise? Your toil must not go for nothing.

sa: नहि रामं तदा कश्चित्कालान्तकयमोपमम्। अनुनेतुमथो वक्तुं द्रष्टुं वाप्यशकत्सुहृत्॥
en: None dared there request, speak with or even look at Rāma like to Death, at the time of dissolution.

sa: सीताया निश्चितं बुद्ध्वा हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः। श्रोत्रानुकूलैर्वचनैस्तदा तां सम्प्रहर्षयन्॥
en: And apprised of Sītā's thought, Hanumān, the Wind-god's son, (replied) in words sweet to her and enhancing her delight.

sa: यथासौ संप्रहृष्टानां वानराणामुपस्थितः। बहूनां सुगहानादो मेघानामिव गर्जताम्॥ सुव्यक्तं महती प्रीतिरेतेषां नात्र संशयः। तथा हि विपुलैनदैिश्चुर्भे लवणार्णवः॥
en: From mighty roars that are heard of in innumerous delighted monkeys, resembling the roar of couds, it is evident, beyond a doubt, that there is great rejoicing there. And the salt Ocean is vexed with these thundering noises.

sa: एवमुक्तास्त्रिजटया राक्षस्यः क्रोधमूर्च्छिताः। सर्वा एवाब्रुवन् भीतास्त्रिजटां तामिदं वचः॥
en: And being thus addressed by Trijatā, those demons, exercised with wrath and terrified, accosted her with the following words.

sa: ततो रामोऽपि संक्रुद्धश्चापमाकृष्य वीर्यवान्। कृतप्रतिकृतं कर्तुं मनसा संप्रचक्रमे॥ रावणध्वजमुद्दिश्य मुमोच निशितं शरम्। महासर्पमिवासा ज्वलन्तं स्वेन तेजसा॥
en: Thereupon the highly powerful Rama, wroth, stretching his bow, made up his mind to return the blow, And aiming at Rāvana's flag staff he discharged a sharpened shaft flaming unbearably by its own lustre like a huge serpent....

sa: सो पश्यंस्तां महाबाहुः पश्यंश्चान्या वरस्त्रियः। विषसाद महाबाहुर्हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः॥
en: Having seen other beauteous females, and not seeing her, the mighty-armed son of the Windgod was oppressed with sandness.

sa: ततोऽस्तमगमत्सूर्यः संध्यया प्रतिरञ्जितः। पूर्णचन्द्रप्रदीप्ता च क्षपा समतिवर्तत ॥
en: Then the Sun, crimsoned with Eve, ascended the Setting-hill; and Night came, illumined by the Moon at his full.

sa: एवमेतत्पुरावृत्तमाख्यानं भद्रमस्तु वः। प्रव्याहरत विस्रब्धं बलं विष्णोः प्रवर्धताम्॥
en: This ancient work produce such fruits. May good betide you. Do you openly declare that Visnu's prowess may increase.

sa: सौम्यं तस्या मुखं दृष्ट्वा हनूमान्प्लवगोत्तमः। रामस्य वचनं सर्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: And beholding her gentle countenance, Hanumān, the best of monkeys, began to relate to her what Räma had said.

sa: सारथेश्चापि बाणेन शिरो ज्वलितकुण्डलम्। जहार लक्ष्मणः श्रीमानैर्ऋतस्य महाबलः॥
en: The mighty and graceful Lakşmaņa with a shafts cut off the head of the Nairta's charioteer, illumined with ear-rings.

sa: ततो राममभिक्रम्य सौमित्रिरभिवाद्य च। तस्थौ भ्रातृसमीपस्थः शक्रस्येन्द्रानुजो यथा।४॥
en: Then going round Rāma and saluted him, Sumitra's son stood before his brother, like Indra's brother staying before Sakra.

sa: उत्तरेण दशग्रीवः प्रविवेशानिवर्तकः। दक्षिणेन तु पार्श्वेन प्रविवेश शतनुतुः॥
en: Dasagriva, incapable of being thwarted, entered by the northern route and the performer of hundred sacrifices by the southern.

sa: निशम्य नदतो नादं वानरास्ते समन्ततः। बभूवुरुत्सुकाः सर्वे सुहृद्दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः॥
en: Hearing those sounds as he kept crying, those monkeys (sitting) around, eager to see their friend, became extremely anxious.

sa: सशङ्खशुक्तिकाजालं समीनमकरं तथा॥ अद्य युद्धेन महता समुद्रं परिशोषये।
en: To day in terrible battle will I dry up the Ocean with conchs and oysters, and fishes and Makaras.

sa: गरुडस्तु समाश्वस्तः संनिवृत्य यथा पुरा। राक्षसान्द्रावयामास पक्षवातेन कोपितः॥
en: Garuda, being cheered, turned round, and growing enraged, as before drove the Rākşasas with the wind of his wings.

sa: लङ्कायां दह्यमानायां शुशुभे च महोदधिः। छायासंसक्तसलिलो लोहितोद इवार्णवे॥
en: On Larkā burning, the mighty main with the reflection (of the conflagration) looked like an ocean of red waters.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अष्टावक्रोऽन्वपृच्छत् तां रूपं विकुरुषे कथम्। न चानृतं ते वक्तव्यं ब्रूहि ब्राह्मणकाम्यया।॥
en: Bhishma said Ashtavakra asked her, saying How do you change your form so? You should not say anything false. I wish to know this. Do you speak truly before a Brahmana.

sa: बलिरुवाच निगृहीते मयि भृशं शक्र किं कत्थितेन ते। वज्रमुद्यम्य तिष्ठन्तं पश्यामि त्वां पुरंदर॥
en: When calamities have assailed me, O Shakra, what do you gain by such brag now? To-day I see you, O Purandara stand before me with the thunder-bolt upraised in your hand.

sa: मृत्योर्ये ते व्याधयश्चाश्रुपाता मनुष्याणां रुज्यते यैः शरीरम्। सवेषां वै प्राणिनां प्राणनान्ते तस्माच्छोकं मा कृथा बुद्ध्य बुद्ध्या॥
en: Those tears that Death had shed are the diseases by which the bodies of men are possessed. At the destruction, therefore, of living creatures, one should not, understanding with the help of the intelligence, give way to grief.

sa: अदृश्यमानो रक्षोभिर्जलमध्ये वदंस्तथा। अब्रुवंश्च पिशाचास्तं नैवं त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Unseen by the Rakshasas while he said this to himself, the Pishachas said to him,-You should not say so!

sa: श्रुत्वा चर्षिस्तद् वचनं शुकस्य प्रीतो महात्मा पुनराह चैनम्। भो भो पुत्र स्थीयतां तावदद्य यावच्चक्षुः प्रीणयामि त्वदर्थे॥
en: Hearing of Shuka's intention, the great Rishi became highly pleased. Addressing him the great Rishi said,-0 son, O dear son, do you stay here to-day so that I may see you for some time for gratifying my eyes.

sa: पुरुष तिष्ठती बुद्धिस्त्रिषु भावेषु वर्तते। कदाचिल्लभते प्रीतिं कदाचिदनुशोचति॥
en: The Intelligence that exists in a living creature embraces the three qualities. Sometimes it obtains happiness and sometimes misery.

sa: ततो राज्यं प्रदास्यामि शक्रायामिततेजसे। देवताः स्थापयिष्यामि स्वस्वस्थानेषु नारद॥
en: I shall restore it to Indra of immeasurable splendour, and replace the gods, O Narada, in their respective stations,

sa: इक्ष्वाकुवंशजस्तस्माद्धरिणाश्वः प्रतापवान्॥ हरिणावादसि लेभे शुनकः शुनकादपि। उशीनरो वै धर्मात्मा तस्माद् भोजः स यादवः॥
en: Raghu gave it to the valiant Harinashva. Harinashva gave the sword to Sunaka, and Sunaka to the righteous-souled Ushinara. From the last it was taken by the Bhojas and the Yadavas.

sa: कुण्डधार उवाच यदि प्रसन्ना देवा मे भक्तोऽयं ब्राह्मणो मम। अस्यानुग्रहमिच्छामि कृतं किंचित् सुखोदयम्॥
en: Thereupon Kundadhara replied,-If, indeed, the gods are gratified with me, there, that Brahmana respects me greatly. I pray for some favour being shown to him, something, that may bring him happiness.

sa: भीष्म उवाच सा तदा तेन विप्रेण तथा तेन निवर्तिता। स्वतन्त्रास्मीत्युवाचर्षिः न धर्मच्छलमस्ति ते॥
en: Bhishma said Thus dissuaded by the Brahmana with the help of his selfcontrol, the lady answered him saying I am my own mistress! In accepting me you will commit no sin.

sa: अपि कीट: पतङ्गो वा भवेयं शङ्कराज्ञया। न तु शक्र त्वया दत्तं त्रैलोक्यमपि कामये॥
en: Ordered by Mahadeva I shall cheerfully become a worm or an insect, but I do not desire for even the sovereignty of the three worlds if bestowed by you, O Shakra.

sa: त्यज धर्ममधर्मं च उभे सत्यानृते त्यज। उभे सत्यानृते त्यक्त्वा येन त्यजसि तं त्यज॥
en: Renounce both virtue and sin! Renounce also truth and falsehood! Having renounced both truth and falsehood, do you then cast off that with whose help you shall cast off the former.

sa: भूतसर्गमिमं कृत्वा सर्वलोकपितामहः। शाश्वतं वेदपठितं धर्म प्रयुयुजे ततः॥
en: Having thus created all mobile and immobile creatures, then the universal Grandfather preached the eternal religion of the Vedas.

sa: पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च पञ्चमम्। बुद्धिरात्मा मनः कालो दिशश्चैव गुणा दश॥ नित्यमेव हि पश्यन्ति देहिनां देहसंश्रिताः। सुकृतं दुष्कृतं चापि कर्म धर्मभृतां वर॥
en: O foremost of the virtuous, the five elements, viz., fire, air, earth, water, and sky, and the mind, the intellect and the Soul, and time and space and the ten organs of sense, are all in the bodies of men and always witness the good and evil deeds of men.

sa: अष्टवक्र उवाच न भद्रे परदारेषु मनो मे सम्प्रसज्जति। उत्तिष्ठ भद्रे भद्रं ते स्वयं वै विरमस्व च॥
en: Ashtavakra said O blessed lady, I am not inclined for sexual union with one who is the wife of another. Leave my bed, O good lady. Blessed be you do, you desist from this of your own accord.

sa: नि:संदिग्धं यथा वाक्यमेतन्मे समुदाहृतम्। तेनाहं विप्र सत्येन स्वयमात्मानमालभे॥
en: As I have truly made this statement, by that truth, O Brahmana, I shall acquire the knowledge of Self.

sa: एवं कथयतस्तस्य महादेवाश्रितां कथाम्॥ दिनान्यष्टौ ततो जग्मुर्मुहूर्तमिव भारत।
en: Eight days, O Bharata, passed there like an hour, all of us being thus occupied with talk on Mahadeva.

sa: देवल उवाच न प्रीयसे वन्धमानो निन्द्यमानो न कुप्यसे। का ते प्रज्ञा कुतश्चैषा किं ते तस्याः परायणम्॥
en: Devala said You are not pleased when lauded, you do not give way to anger when blamed or censured. What, indeed, is your wisdom? whence have you got it? And what, indeed, is the refuge of that wisdom?

sa: एवमेष महाबाहुः केशवः सत्यविक्रमः। अचिन्त्यः पुण्डरीकाक्षो नैष केवलमानुषः॥
en: Thus, O mighty-armed one, is Keshava of unvanquishable prowess. That lotus-eyed one is not a man. He is inconceivable!'

sa: दानवैरर्चमानास्तु देवा देवर्षयस्तथा। न शर्म लेभिरे राजन् विशमानास्ततस्ततः॥
en: Oppressed by the Danavas and finding no peace, the gods and the celestial Rishis, fled away in all directions.

sa: न मन्ये भ्रूणहत्यापि विशिष्टा तेन कर्मणा। कृषि साध्विति मन्यन्ते सा च वृत्तिः सुदारुणा॥
en: I think that such acts of injury done to animals are the same as foeticide. People consider the calling of agriculture as sinless. That profession, however, is again fraught with cruelty.

sa: दिवसे दिवसे नाम रात्रौ रात्रौ पुमान् सदा। भोक्तव्यमिति यः खिन्नो दोषबुद्धिः स उच्यते॥
en: That man who is really affected by sorrow for being compelled to eat every day and every night for maintaining life, is said to be congnisant of the faults of life.

sa: ऋषिस्तमाह देया मे सुता तुभ्यं हि तच्छृणु। गच्छ तावद् दिशं पुण्यामुत्तरां द्रक्ष्यसे ततः॥
en: The Rishi addressed Ashtavakra and said Yes, I shall give my daughter to you. Listen, however, to me. Make a journey to the sacred North. You will see inany things there.

sa: ततः शरीरं लोकस्थं स्थापयित्वा पितामहः। जनयामास भगवान् पुत्रानुत्तमतेजसः॥
en: Assuming a visible form the divine Grandfather then begot (by the power of his will) some highly energetic sons.

sa: कृष्यादीनीह कर्माणि सस्यसंहरणानि च। प्रज्ञावद्भिः प्रक्लृप्तानि यानासनगृहाणि च॥
en: Wise men take to agriculture and tillage, and the acquisition of crops and of vehicles, seats, carpets and houses.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कथं निर्वेदमापन्नः शुको वैयासकिः पुरा। एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं परं कौतूहलं हि मे॥
en: Yudhishthira said How was Shuka the son of Vyasa, in days of yore, won over to Renunciation? I wish to hear you recite the story. My curiosity about it is irrepressible.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच पित्र्यं वाप्यथवा दैवं दीयते यत् पितामह। एतदिच्छाम्यहं ज्ञातुं दत्तं केषु महाफलम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said I wish O grandfather, to know who those persons are by giving to whom the things dedicated to the gods and the departed manes, one may acquire sufficient rewards.

sa: दक्षिणापथजन्मानः सर्वे नरवरान्ध्रकाः। गुहाः पुलिन्दाः शबराश्चूचुका मद्रकैः सह॥
en: Those men, O king, are born in the southern region and are called Andhakas, Gushes, Palinodes, Shavers, Chuchukas, Madrakas.

sa: स्वाहास्वधावषट्कारा यत्र सम्यगनुष्ठिताः। अजस्रं चैव वर्तन्ते वसेत् तत्राविचारयन्॥
en: One should unhesitatingly live in that country where the sounds Svaha, Svadha, and Vashat are duly and continuously uttered.

sa: यस्यां यस्यां दिशि ोते तां दिशं शरणं गतः। मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यः स्वस्तिमांश्च गृहान् व्रजेत्॥
en: By reciting their names one is purged off of all his sins. A person by sojourning to those quarters becomes freed of all his sins and succeeds in returning home safely.'

sa: यथा रुरुः शृङ्गमथो पुराणं हित्वा त्वचं वाप्युरगो यथा च। स्तथा विमुक्तो विजहाति दुःखम्॥
en: As the Ruru deer casting off its hold horns or the snake casting off slough passes on without arresting any notice, similarly a person who is unattached renounces all his sorrows.

sa: गृहस्थधर्मं विप्रेन्द्र कृत्वा पुत्रगतं त्वहम्। धर्म परमकं कुर्यां को हि मार्गो भवेद् द्विज॥
en: O foremost of Brahmanas, making over the duties of a house-holder to my son, I wish to satisfy the highest duties of man. What, O twice-born one, should be my path?

sa: न धर्मवचनं वाचा नैव बुद्ध्येति नः श्रुतम्। इति बार्हस्पतं ज्ञानं प्रोवाच मघवा स्वयम्॥
en: We have heard that the texts of morality cannot be understood by either discussion or one's own intelligence. Indra himself has said that such is the opinion of the sage Brihaspati.

sa: सर्वभूतगणाश्चैव मातरो विविधाः स्थिताः। तेऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं परिवार्य समन्ततः॥
en: All the clans of spirits and ghosts, and the celestial Mothers, stood surrounding Mahadeva and saluting him with respect.

sa: यथा मृणालानुगतमाशु मुञ्चति कर्दमम्। तथाऽऽत्मा पुरुषस्येह मनसा परिमुच्यते॥
en: As the lotus stalk quickly leaves the mire attached to it, so the Soul can quickly renounce the mind.

sa: एवं त्वमपि कौन्तेय पृथिव्यामपराजितः। भविष्यसि यथा देवः शतक्रतुरमित्रहा॥
en: You will, also, O of Kunti, unvanquished on Earth, become another Indra and the killer of all your enemies.

sa: सुसुखं बत जीवामि यस्य मे नास्ति किंचन। मिथिलायां प्रदीप्तायां न मे दह्यति किंचन॥
en: The king of the Videhas said, I have nothing, yet I live in great happiness. If the whole of Mithila be reduced to ashes nothing of mine will be burnt down.

sa: त्रैलोक्यविख्यातगुणं त्वं विप्रं जनयिष्यसि। सा च क्षत्रं विशिष्टं वै तत एतत् कृतं मया॥
en: I had so settled that you would give birth to a Brahmana whose virtues would be famous throughout the three worlds, and that she would give birth to an excellent Kshatriya.

sa: इदं यः कथयेद् विद्वानहन्यहनि भारत। सुदर्शनस्य चरितं पुण्याँल्लोकानवाप्नुयात्॥
en: And, O Bharata, the learned man who daily recites this story of the life of Sudarshana acquires blessed regions.

sa: अहं त्वयि मयि त्वं च मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम्। पूर्वसम्बन्धिसंयोग नैतद् दान्तो निषेवते॥
en: The self-controlled man is never fettered by the attachments originating from earthly connections and sentiments like these,-'I am yours, You are yours. They are in me, and I am in them.

sa: ततो महर्षयः सर्वे सर्वे देवगणास्तथा॥ जयेनाद्भुतकल्पेन देवदेवं तथार्चयन्।
en: Then all the Rishis and all the gods adored that god of gods with loud cries of his victory.

sa: पञ्चयज्ञांस्तु यो मोहान्न करोति गृहाश्रमे। तस्य नायं न च परो लोको भवति धर्मतः॥
en: If one, while living like a house-holder, does, not from want of judgement, celebrate the five sacrifices, one loses, as laid down in the scriptures, both this and the next world.

sa: विरूप उवाच धारयामि नरव्याघ्र विकृतस्येह गोः फलम्। ददतश्च न गृह्णाति विकृतो मे महीपते॥
en: Virupa said I owe my companion Vikrita, O king, the merits of the gift of a cow. I am willing to satisfy that debt. This Vikrita, however, refuses to accept repayment.

sa: तत्र सा विप्रहायाथ पूर्वरूपं हि योगतः। अबिभ्रदनवद्याङ्गी रूपमन्यदनुत्तमम्॥
en: Abandoning, by her Yoga powers, her former body and features, Sulabha assumed the most perfect features and peerless beauty.

sa: धर्मस्य वसवः पुत्रा रुद्राश्चामिततेजसः। विश्वेदेवाश्च साध्याश्च मरुत्वन्तश्च भारत॥
en: Dharma became father of the Vasus, the highly energetic Rudras the Vishvedevas, the Saddhyas, and the Maruts, O Bharata.

sa: ततः संजीवितस्तेन बकराजस्तदानघ। उत्पत्य च समीयाय विरूपाक्षं बकाधिपः॥
en: There at the prince of cranes became revived. Rising up, came to his friend Virupaksha, the king of Rakshasas.

sa: दर्शने दर्शने नित्यं सुखप्रश्नमुदाहरेत्। सायं प्रातश्च विप्राणां प्रदिष्टमभिवादनम्॥
en: One should make polite enquiries every time he meets with another. One should salute Brahmanas every morning and evening.

sa: तस्य ता विपुला: शाखा दृष्ट्वा स्कन्धं च सर्वशः। अभिगम्याब्रवीदेनं नारदो भरतर्षभ॥ अहो नु रमणीयस्त्वमहो चासि मनोहरः। प्रीयामहे त्वया नित्यं तरुप्रवर शाल्मले॥
en: One day, O foremost of Bharata's race, seeing the wide-extending and numberless branches of that tree and the circumference of his trunk, the sage Narada, approached and addressed him, saying,-O, you are delightful! O, you are charming! O foremost of trees, O Shalmali, I am always pleased to see you.

sa: नायं लोकोऽस्ति न परो न च पूर्वान् स तारयेत्। कुत एव जनिष्यांस्तु मृषावादपरायणः॥
en: He who is given to falsehood has neither this world nor the next. Such a person cannot rescue his departed manes. How again shall he succeed in doing good to progeny?

sa: न तस्मै धारयेद् दण्डं राजा धर्मेण धर्मवित्। क्षत्रियस्य तु बालिश्या ब्राह्मणः क्लिश्यते क्षुधा॥
en: If the king knows his own duty he should not punish such a Brahmana. He should remember that a Brahmana becomes stricken with hunger only through the fault of the Kshatriya.

sa: भीष्म उवाच कल्यमर्थं निषेवेत ततो धर्ममनन्तरम्। पश्चात् कामं निषेवेत न च गच्छेत् प्रसङ्गिताम्॥
en: Bhishma said One should acquire riches the first part of his life. Then should one acquire virtue, and then enjoy pleasure. One should not, however, be addicted to any of these.

sa: सनत्कुमारादपि च वीरणो वै प्रजापतिः। कृतादौ कुरुशार्दूल धर्ममेतदधीतवान्॥
en: From Santakumara, the Prajapati Virana, in the beginning of the Krita age, O foremost of Kurus, obtained this religion.

sa: वयमेव हृषीकेशं निगृह्णीन बलादिव। प्रसह्य पुरुषव्याघ्रमिन्द्रो वैरोचनि यथा॥
en: But we shall capture that best among men, Hrishikesha, by force like Indra seizing the son of Virochana (Vali).

sa: न स्वप्नेन जयेन्निद्रां न कामेन जयेत् स्त्रियः। नेन्धनेन जयेदग्नि न पानेन सुरां जयेत्॥
en: The inclination to sleep cannot be got over by lying down; women cannot be won by desire; fire cannot be won by wood and excess drinking cannot be conquered by drinking.

sa: अभ्यावहति कल्याणं विविधं वाक् सुभाषिता। सैव दुर्भाषिता राजन्ननायोपपद्यते॥
en: Words spoken sweetly bring on several of the blessings; and the same (words) spoken harshly, O king generate evils.

sa: व्यपोढाभ्रस्ततः कालः क्षणेन समपद्यत। शिवश्चानुववौ वायुः प्रशान्तमभवद् रजः॥
en: And in a moment the sky became cloudless; and favourable winds blew; and the weather became calm and serene.

sa: सभायां तु विराटस्य करोमि कदनं महत्। तत्र मे कारणं भाति कौन्तेयो यत् प्रतीक्षते॥
en: I would have caused a great havoc in the court of Virata but the son of Kunti looked at me (by way of forbidding); that was the reason of my forbearance.

sa: चत्वारि ते तात गृहे वसन्तु श्रियाभिजुष्टस्य गृहस्थधर्मे। वृद्धो ज्ञातिरवसन्नः कुलीनः सखादरिद्रो भगिनी चानपत्या॥
en: Let these four dwell at your house, O sire, who a householder crowned with are prosperity; viz., aged and worn out cousins, men of noble families, destitute friends and childless sisters.

sa: नाल्पं कृतं मया भीम देवानां किल्बिषं पुरा। अभाग्या यत्र जीवामि कर्तव्ये सति पाण्डव॥
en: O Bhima, surely had I committed many sinful acts to gods in my former days. Unfortunate as I am, I am still alive, my death is preferable to me, O Pandava.

sa: प्रमाणरूपसम्पन्नः पीत आकाशसंनिभः। कस्य हेममये कोशे सुतप्ते पावकप्रभ॥
en: Whose is this sword sable like the cloud and cased in a case of burning gold shining like fire?

sa: न च धर्मादपक्रामेदच्युतः पुरुषोत्तमः। विदुरेणैवमुक्ते तु केशवो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Achyuta, the best among men swerves from the Path of rectitude." Vidura having said this, Keshava said these words,

sa: निस्त्रिंशोऽयं गुरुः पीतः सायक: परनिर्वणः। कस्यायमसितः खड्गो हेमबिन्दुभिरावृतः॥
en: Whose is this huge sable Nishtringha capable of assaulting others? Whose is this iron sword covered with golden points.

sa: रोगार्दिता न फलान्याद्रियन्ते न वै लभन्ते विषयेषु तत्त्वम्। दुःखोपेता रोगिणो नित्यमेव न बुध्यन्ते धनभोगान् न सौख्यम्॥
en: They that are affected with disease do not appreciate enjoyments; not do they gain any pleasure from wealth. Those that are affected with disease and so filled with sorrow do not know what enjoyment, proceeding from wealth, is.

sa: न चेद् ग्रहीष्यसे वाक्यं श्रोतासि सुबहून् हतान्। तवैव हि मतं सर्वे कुरवः पर्युपासते॥
en: If you do not accept my advice; then you will hear of the slaying of numerous men of your army; my advice is listen to by all the sons of Kuru.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच न स देवासुरैः शक्यो युद्धे जेतुं विभावसो। विहितं तत्र यत् कार्यमभितस्तस्य निग्रहः॥
en: Brahma said: O Vibhavasu, he cannot slain in battle either by the celestials or the Asuras I have already ordained what is necessary for this purpose. But his death is near.

sa: उत्तिष्ठति महाराजे धृतराष्ट्र जनेश्वरे। तानि राजसहस्राणि समुत्तस्थुः समन्ततः॥
en: The great king Dhritarashtra, the lord of men, having got up, those thousands of kings all rose up also.

sa: बहूदकं सुयवसं तुषाङ्गारसमन्वितम्। शिबिरे शिबिरे राजा संचकारं युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: And plenty of water and fodder for cattle and chaff and fire, the king Yudhishthira placed in each tent.

sa: दक्षिणां दक्षिणाचारो दिशं येनाजयत् प्रभुः। अपज्यमकरोद् वीरः सहदेवस्तदायुधम्॥
en: The heroic Sahadeva of noble conduct rendered his bow stringless with which he made conquests in the southern regions.

sa: अविसंवादनं दानं समयस्याव्यतिक्रमः आवर्तयन्ति भूतानि सम्यकप्रणिहिता च वाक्॥
en: Absence of deceitfulness, gift, observance of the respect due to others, subjugate all creature, so does well conducted speech.

sa: राक्षसं शङ्कमानस्तं विकृष्य बलवद् धनुः। अभ्यधावत काकुत्स्थस्ततस्तं सहलक्ष्मणः॥
en: Suspecting him to be a Rakshasa, the descendant of Kakustha drawing his bow powerfully, rushed at him with Lakshmana.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु स मुनिः कन्यया गालवस्तदा। हर्यश्वं पृथिवीपालमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: was The Muni Galava, being thus addressed by that said these words to the lord of the earth, Haryashva.

sa: अपत्यार्थे परं यत्नमकरोच्च विशेषतः। सा ददर्शाथ मञ्जूषामुह्यमानां यदृच्छया॥
en: Although, she made the very best endeavours to obtain one. She, then, beheld drifting along the stream, a basket.

sa: विभीषणस्तु धर्मात्मा सतां मार्गमनुस्मरन्। अन्वगच्छन्महाराज श्रिया परमया युतः॥
en: Always wending the way of the pious, those virtuous-souled Vibhishana, endued with great glory, followed him, O great king.

sa: कर्ण उवाच सर्वानायुष्मतो भीतान् संत्रस्तानिव लक्षये। अयुद्धमनसश्चैव सर्वांश्चैवानवस्थितान्॥
en: Karna said I see all of you looking as if terrified and panic-stricken, not resolute and reluctant to fight.

sa: जनार्दनं भीमसेनार्जुनौ च माद्रीसुतौ सात्यकिं चेकितानम्। आमन्त्र्य गच्छामि शिवं सुखः वः सौम्येन मां पश्यत चक्षुषा नृपाः॥
en: After bidding adieu also to Janardana, Bhimasena, Arjuna, the two sons of Madri, Satyaki and Chekitana, shall I go away. May happiness and prosperity be yours. May the king look upon us with an eye of good will.

sa: उत्पाद्य पुत्राननृणांश्च कृत्वा वृत्तिं च तेभ्योऽनुविधाय कांचित्। स्थाने कुमारी: प्रतिपाद्य सर्वा अरण्यसंस्थोऽथ मुनिळूभूषेत्॥
en: After begetting sons and making them independent by providing for them and after giving away all the unmarried daughters to suitable bridegrooms, one should dwell in the wood like a Muni.

sa: सोऽस्य दोषो न मन्तव्यः क्षमा हि परमं बलम्। क्षमा गुणो ह्यशक्तानां भूषणं क्षमा॥
en: This defect in such a man need not be made too much of; forgiveness is a great power. For the weak as well as for the strong forgiveness is an ornament.

sa: सखिभावाच्च सुग्रीवः कुशलं त्वानुपृच्छति। क्षिप्रमेष्यति ते भर्ता सर्वशाखामृगैः सह॥ प्रत्ययं कुरु मे देवि वानरोऽस्मि न राक्षसः।
en: And Sugriva too being a friend (of them) has enquired of your welfare. Your husband will soon arrive (here) accompanied by all the monkeys. O divine lady, believe in me. I am a monkey and not a Rakshasa.

sa: ये राजानः पाण्डवायोधनाय समानीता धार्तराष्ट्रण केचित्। वशातयः शाल्वकाः केकयाश्च तथाम्बष्ठा ये त्रिगर्ताश्च मुख्याः॥
en: Those kings who have been brought together by the son of Dhritarashtra for fighting with the Pandavas, the Vashati, the Shalvakas, the Kaikeyas, the Ambasthan and the chief among the Trigartas.

sa: तस्मात् स त्वं कुरुश्रेष्ठ मा शुचो भरतर्षभ। त्वद्विधा हि महात्मानो न शोचन्ति परंतप॥
en: Therefore, O best of the Kurus, O most exalted of the Bharata, do not grieve over all this. O tormentor of foes, high-minded men like you never give way to sorrow.

sa: विशेषत इहास्माकं निमित्तानि निवेशने। उल्काभिहि प्रदीप्ताभिर्बाध्यते पृतना तव॥
en: Especially are these omens seen in our encampment. Burning meteors again are coming in the way of your army.

sa: स्तुल्यो दण्डः स्पृशते मिश्रभावात्। शुष्केणार्दै दह्यते मिश्रभावात् तस्मात् पापैः सह सन्धिं न कुर्यात्॥
en: Equal punishment overtakes the sinless with the sinful, when these two constantly associate; even as the wet fuel burns with the dry. Therefore friendship should not be established with the sinful.

sa: सप्राकारं सपरिखं सवप्रं चारुतोरणम्। कृष्णश्च परिघस्तत्र भानुमावृत्य तिष्टति॥
en: With walls, with trenches, with beautiful porticoes and pillars dirty in the sky is seen to surround the sun.

sa: तपनीयस्य शुद्धस्य षष्टिर्यस्येन्द्रगोपकाः। पृष्ठे विभक्ताः शोभन्ते कस्यैतद् धनुरुत्तमम्॥
en: Whose is this excellent bow embellished with three scores of golden insects placed with proper divisions on its back?

sa: तस्य योधा महावीर्या नानादेशसमागताः। नानाप्रहरणा वीराः शोभयाञ्चक्रिरे बलम्॥
en: His warriors of great strength, came from many countries and heroes, holding many suits of weapons, beautified the army.

sa: अध्यारोहेद् यथा वृक्षान् वधायैवात्मनो नरः। राजवेश्मनि ते सुभ्रु गृहे तु स्यात् तथा मम॥
en: As a person climbs up a tree for his own destruction, so, O you of graceful eyebrows, your stay in this royal house-hold will bring out the same result to me.

sa: दुर्योधन निबोधेदं यत् त्वां वक्ष्यामि पुत्रक। तथा तत् कुरु भद्रं ते यद्यस्ति पितृगौरवम्॥
en: "O Duryodhana, listen to what I am going to say, my dear son, and act according to that if you entertain respect for your father. It will be well with you.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच सुकृतं ते कृतं राजन् प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना। दुर्योधनस्य यद् वीर त्वया वाचा प्रतिश्रुतम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said "O king, a good act has been done by you in that you have fulfilled a promise made when you were well pleased in the recesses of your heart.

sa: न सम्भ्रमं गन्तुमहं हि शक्ष्ये त्वया नृशंसेन विकृष्यमाणा। समागताहं हि कुरुप्रवीरैः पुनर्वनं काम्यकमागतास्मि॥
en: Ruthless as you are, you cannot terrify me by seizing me violently; for as soon as those Kuru heroes will see me they will bring me back to the Kamyaka forest.

sa: अमृष्यमाणस्तद् भीष्मो जानन्नपि स पाण्डवम्। दिव्येनास्त्रेण महता धनंजयप्रवाकिरत्॥
en: Unable to bear this, Bhishma though he knew Arjuna's prowess covered Dhananjaya, the son of Pandu with celestials weapons.

sa: अथैनमब्रवीत् पार्थो भयार्तं नष्टचेतसम्। यदि नोत्सहसे योद्धं शत्रुभिः शत्रुकर्षण। एहि मे त्वं हयान् यच्छ युध्यमानस्य शत्रुभिः॥
en: Partha then said to him who was stricken with fear and deprived of his senses. “O repressor of foes, if you do not like to fight with your enemies, come, govern the horses while I fight with them.

sa: ततो हलहलाशब्दः प्रादुरासीद् विशाम्पते। हाहाकाराश्च बहवो नगरे नागसाह्वये॥
en: O king, then rose in the city of Hastinapur a great uproar and also cries of "Oh" and "Alas".

sa: यक्षो वाप्यथवा देवो गन्धर्वो राक्षसोऽपि वा। न हि मानुषरूपोऽसि को वाऽर्थः काइझ्यते त्वया।।१६।
en: Are you a Yakasha or a god, a Gandharva or a Rakshasa, for you have not the appearance of a human being; and what is the object desired for by you?”

sa: सूपकारं विराटस्य बल्लवं त्वां विदुर्जनाः। प्रेष्यत्वं समनुप्राप्त ततो दुःखतरं नु किम्॥ यदा महानसे सिद्धे विराटमुपतिष्ठसि। ब्रुवाणो बल्लव: सूदस्तदा सीदति मे मनः॥
en: What can be more distressful than this that people should know you as Virata's cook Ballava by name and fallen into servitude. When you wait on the king Virata calling yourself as Ballava the cook after getting through the work of the kitchen, then my very niind sinks into despair.

sa: सुखस्यानन्तरं दुःखं दुःखस्यानन्तरं सुखम्। पर्यायेणोपसर्पन्ते नरं नेमिमरा इव॥
en: Misery after happiness and happiness after misery revolve by turns round a man like a wheel round its axile.

sa: ततः स राजा सिन्धूनां वार्द्धक्षत्रिर्जयद्रथः। विस्मितस्त्वनवद्यागीं दृष्ट्वा दुष्टमानसः॥
en: Seeing that lady of faultless feature, Jayadratha, the king of Sindhu, the son of Vriddhakshatra, possessed by evil intention.

sa: पुनर्नरो म्रियते जायते च पुनर्नरो हीयते वर्धते च। पुनर्नरो याचति याच्यते च पुनर्नरः शोचति शोच्यते च॥
en: A man again and again both dies and is born; a man again and again withers and grows; a man again and again asks and is asked; and a man again and again laments and is lamented for.

sa: पुनः संजीवमानस्य तस्योत्पतितुमिच्छतः। पदा मूर्ध्नि महाबाहुः प्राहरद् विलपिष्यतः॥
en: When regaining his consciousness he expressed his desire of getting up the mightyarmcu herces kicked him on the head.

sa: कौरवैः सह संगत्य त्रिगर्तेश्च विशाम्पते। गास्तस्यापहरामोऽद्य सर्वेश्चैव सुसंहताः॥
en: O emperor, uniting the Kaurava army with Trigarta, we will today carry away his collections of kine with all.

sa: ततः स वह्निप्रतिमो महाकपिः सहैव भूतैर्दिवमुत्पपात। तथैव माया विहिता बभूव ध्वजं च सैंह युयुजे रथे पुनः॥
en: Then that huge monkey, resembling the fire, got up into the sky with other creatures. In the same way the illusion died away, and he twisted his banner, having the emblem of a lion again on his car.

sa: देवैरप्यापदः प्राप्ताश्च्छन्नैश्च बहुशस्तथा। तत्र तत्र सपत्नानां निग्रहार्थं महात्मभिः॥
en: Even the high-souled gods themselves have wandered over various places in concealment, for the purpose of destroying the enemies.

sa: बाल्यात् प्रसुप्तस्य महाबलस्य सिंहस्य पक्ष्माणि मुखाल्लुनासि। पदा समाहत्य पलायमानः क्रुद्धं यदा द्रक्ष्यसि भीमसेनम्॥
en: Out of childishness, you are arousing a sleeping lion to pluck the hair from off his face. You shall however have to run away when you shall sec the enraged Bhimasena.

sa: एवं युक्ताङ्गरूपस्य लक्षणैः सूचितस्य च। केन कर्मविपाकेन क्लीबत्वमिदमागतम्॥
en: By what adverse circumstances may such a handsome person, gifted with all auspicious marks, become deprived of men hood?

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु सुश्रोण्या तया सख्या परंतपः। जगाम राजपुत्रस्य सकाशममितौजसः॥ तमाव्रजन्तं त्वरितं प्राभन्नमिव कुवारम्। अन्वगच्छद् विशालक्षी गजं गजवधूरिव॥
en: Of incomparable energy went to the prince. The large eyed (princess) followed him who was proceeding quickly like an elephant in rut as a she-elephant runs after its young one. Seeing him from a distance the prince said.

sa: पौत्रस्यार्थं भवांस्तस्माद् गुणकेशी प्रतीच्छतु। सदृशी प्रतिरूपस्य वासवस्य शचीमिव॥
en: Therefore do you accept for your grandson Gunakeshi, who equals, in point of beauty, Sachi, the queen of Vasava.

sa: नकुलः सहदेवो वा द्रौपदी वा यशस्विनी। यदा द्यूतजिताः पार्था न प्राज्ञायन्त ते क्वचित्॥
en: Which of them is Nakula, who Sahadeva and where is the illustrious Draupadi? From the time of their defeat at dice, the sons of Pritha have not been known by any.

sa: वसुवर्मधरं दृष्ट्वा तं बालं हेमकुण्डलम्। नामास्य वसुषेणेति ततश्चक्रुर्द्विजातयः॥
en: The twice-born ones seeing the boy ciad in a golden armour and adorned with golden earrings called him Vasusena.

sa: स कृत्वा पृथिवीं कृत्स्ना शासने पृथिवीपतिः। सुरलोकमितो जेतुमुद्योगमकरोनृपः॥
en: Having brought the whole world under his subjection the king Māndhātā engaged in the conquest of the celestial region.

sa: सत्येन वै द्यौश्च वसुन्धरा च तथैवाग्निर्चलते मानुषेषु। न मे वृथा व्यहृतमेव वाक्यं सत्यं हि सन्तः प्रतिपूजयन्ति॥
en: The firmament and earth still exist owing to my truth and virtue. Fire and burns owing to my truth and virtue. Never a word has been uttered by me which is not true. The wise, therefore, adore truth.

sa: पूरोस्तु भार्या कौसल्या नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे जनमेजयो नाम; यस्त्रीनश्वमेधानाजहार, विश्वजिता चेष्टवा वनं विवेश॥
en: Puru had a wife, named Kaushalya and he begot on her a son named Janamejaya. He performed three great Horse-sacrifices and a sacrifice called Vishvajit. He then retired into a forest.

sa: स खलु कालिङ्गीं करम्भां नामोपयेमे। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे देवातिथिः॥
en: Akrodhana married Karambha, the daughter of the king of Kalinga and she gave birth to a son, called Devatithi.

sa: तत्र धृतराष्ट्रस्य राज्ञः पुत्रशतं बभूव गान्धार्यां वरदानाद् द्वैपायनस्य॥
en: The king Dhritarashtra begot one hundred sons on his wife Gandhari on account of the boon granted by Dvaipayana.

sa: इति देवासुराणां ते गन्धर्वाप्सरसां तथा। अंशावतरणं राजन् राक्षसानां च कीर्तितम्॥ ये पृथिव्यां समुद्धृता राजानो युद्धदुर्मदाः। महात्मानो यदूनां च ये जाता विपुले कुले॥ ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्या मया ते परिकीर्तिताः। धन्यं यशस्यं पुत्रीयमायुष्यं विजयावहम्। इदमंशावतरणं श्रोतव्यमनसूयता॥
en: Thus, O king, have I described to you the births and incarnations of the portions of the Devas, Asuras, Gandharvas, Apsaras and Rakshasas, those that appeared on earth as invincible kings. Those illustrious ones that were born in the extensive race of the Yadus, those that were born as Brahmanas, Kshatriyas and Vaishyas, have all been described. This Anshavatarana (accounts of incarnations), which is capable of bestowing wealth, fame, long-life, offspring and victory, should be heard with proper frame of mind.

sa: यस्तु वर्चा इति ख्यातः सोमपुत्रः प्रतापवान्। सोऽभिमन्युर्वृहत्कीर्तिरर्जुनस्य सुतोऽभवत्॥
en: He, who was known as Varcha the son of Soma, became Abhimanyu of wonderful deeds, the son of Arjuna.

sa: शतं दुःशासनादीनां सर्वेषां क्रूरकर्मणाम्। दुर्मुखो दुःसहश्चैव ये चान्येनानुकीर्तिताः॥
en: They were hundred, Dushasana Durmukha, Dusaha and others, all wicked to the extreme. I do not mention their names.

sa: अरिष्टायास्तु यः पुत्रो हंस इत्यभिविश्रुतः। स गन्धर्वपतिर्जज्ञे कुरुवंशविवर्धनः॥
en: That son of Arishta, known as Hansa, the king of the Gandharvas, was born to increase the Kuru race.

sa: क्रोधहन्तेति यस्तस्य बभूवावरजोऽसुरः। दण्ड इत्यभिविख्यातः स आसीनृपतिः क्षितौ॥
en: That Asura, who was the younger brother of Vritra and was known as Krodhahanta, became king Danda on earth.

sa: ततः शान्तनवो धीमान् सत्यवत्यामजायता वीरश्चित्राङ्गदो नाम वीर्यवान् पुरुषेश्वरः॥
en: Thereupon, the wise Shantanu begot on his wife Satyavati a very powerful hero, named Chitrangada, the best of men.

sa: तथैवाङ्गिरसः पुत्रः सुरासुरनमस्कृतः। यद् वेद शास्त्रं तचापि कृत्स्नमस्मिन् प्रतिष्ठितम्॥ तव पुत्रे महाबाहौ साङ्गोपाङ्गं महात्मनि। ऋषिः परैरनाधृप्यो जामदग्न्यः प्रतापवान्॥ यदस्त्रं वेद रामश्च तदेतस्मिन् प्रतिष्ठितम्। महेष्वासमिमं राजन् राजधर्मार्थकोविदम्॥ मया दत्तं निजं पुत्रं वीरं वीर गृहं नय।
en: All the Vedas and Shastras that are known by the son of Angirasa (Brihaspati), adored of the celestials and Asuras, he is master of them all. All the weapons that were known to the powerful and invincible son of Jamadagni (Parashurama) are fully and completely known to your this illustrious and mighty-armed son. king, this boy is a great bow-man and learned in the treatises on the duties of kings. O hero, take home your this heroic son given by me.

sa: सूक्ष्मस्तु मतिमानराजन्कीर्तिमान्यः प्रकीर्तितः। बृहद्रथ इति ख्यातः क्षितावासीत्स पार्थिवः॥
en: O king, the intelligent and illustrious Asura who was known as Sukshma, became the illustrious king Brihadratha on earth.

sa: अप्राप्तवति तस्मिंस्तु यौवनं पुरुषर्षभे। स राजा शान्तनुर्धीमान् कालधर्ममुपेयिवान्॥
en: Before that best of men, Vichitravirya, had attained the majority, his father succumbed to the inevitable influence of Time.

sa: ततो भीष्मं शान्तनवं शरैः शतसहस्रशः। शाल्वराजो नरश्रेष्ठः समवाकिरदाशुगैः॥
en: The best of men, king Shalva, covered the son of Shantanu, Bhishma, with hundreds and thousands of swift-winged arrows.

sa: तस्य कालेन महता तस्मिंस्तपसि वर्ततः। तमाश्रममनुप्राप्ता दस्यवो लोप्पहारिणः॥
en: As he passed years together (in that state), one day (some) robbers came to his hermitage with stolen properties.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रश्च पाण्डुश्च विदुरश्च महामतिः। जन्मप्रभृति भीष्मेण पुत्रवत् परिपालिताः॥
en: Dhritarashtra, Pandu and Vidura were brought up from their birth by Bhishma, as if they were his own sons.

sa: गान्धार्यपि वरारोहा शीलाचारविचेष्टितैः। तुष्टिं कुरूणां सर्वेषां जनयामास भारत॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, the beautiful Gandhari pleased all the Kurus by her behaviour and respectful attentions.

sa: एका शताधिका बाला भविष्यति कनीयसी। ततो दौहित्रजाल्लोकादबाह्योऽसौ पतिर्मम॥
en: My husband may then go to those worlds that the possession of a daughter's sons confers on a man.

sa: श्रुत्वा तेभ्यस्ततः सर्वं यथावृत्तं महावने। धृतराष्ट्रो नरश्रेष्ठः पाण्डुमेवान्वशोचत॥
en: Having heard all that had happened in the great forest, the best of men, king Dhritarashtra, wept for Pandu.

sa: स चेदिविषयं रम्यं वसुः पौरवनन्दनः। इन्द्रोपदेशाज्जग्राह रमणीयं महीपतिः॥
en: That son of Paurava, (Uparichara) called also Vasu, directed by Indra, conquered the beautiful and excellent kingdom of Chedi.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वाब्रवीन्माद्रीं सकृच्चिन्तय दैवतम्। तस्मात् ते भवितापत्यमनुरूपमसंशयम्॥
en: Having been thus addressed, Kunti said to Madri, “Think of some celestials, from whom you will certainly get offspring."

sa: शौनक उवाच भृगुवंशात्प्रभृत्येव त्वया मे कीर्तितं महत्। आख्यानमखिलं तात सौते प्रीतोऽस्मि तेन ते॥
en: Shaunaka said: O child, O Sauti, you have narrated to me this great and extensive history of the Bhrigu race from the birth of Bhrigu. I am much pleased with you.

sa: तस्य धर्मादपेतस्य पापानि परिपश्यतः। मोहादैश्वर्यलोभाच्च पापा मतिर जायत॥
en: The wicked and unrighteous (Duryodhana), through ignorance and ambition (of possessing wealth), inclined to commit acts of sin. son

sa: ततः सर्वं यथावृत्तमाख्याय भुजगोत्तमः। अगच्छच्छरणं भीत आगस्कृत्वा पुरंदरम्॥
en: That best of snakes told every thing to Indra and having acknowledged his fault, asked his protection in fear,

sa: पाञ्चालो राजपुत्रश्च यज्ञसेनो महाबलः। इष्वस्त्रहेतोय॑वसत् तस्मिन्नेव गुरौ प्रभुः॥
en: The prince of Panchala, the greatly powerful Yajnasena also lived there with the same motive (as that of mine).

sa: ततः सर्पाः समापेतुः प्रदीप्ते हव्यवाहने। विचेष्टमानाः कृपणमाह्वयन्तः परस्परम्॥
en: Thereupon the snakes fell into the blazing fire one after another, each be-numbed and calling piteously to one another.

sa: सताशिष्यान् महेष्वासः प्रतिजग्राह कौरवान्। पाण्डवान् धार्तराष्ट्रांश्च द्रोणो मुदितमानसः॥
en: That great bowman, Drona, in delightful heart, accepted the Kurus, the sons of Dhritarashtra and Pandu, as his pupils.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु स मुनिर्भार्यां वचनमब्रवीत्। यद्युक्तमनुरूपं च जरत्कारुं तपोधनः॥
en: Thus addressed, the great ascetic Rishi spoke to his wife Jaratkaru, these words, proper and suitable to the occasion.

sa: अधः प्रविष्टान्पश्यास्मान्यथा दुष्कृतिनस्तथा। अस्मासु पतितेष्वत्र सह सर्वैः सबान्धवैः॥
en: Behold like sinful wretches we are going downwards. On our going with all our relatives down into this hole,

sa: पितरस्तेऽवलम्बन्ते गर्ते दीना अधोमुखाः। साधु दारान्कुरुष्वेति प्रजामुत्पादयेति च॥
en: “Your ancestors are hanging in grief with their faces downwards. O holy man, take a wife and beget offspring.

sa: सलिलादुत्थितो वह्निर्येन व्याप्तं चराचरम्। दधीचस्यास्थितो वज्रं कृतं दानवसूदनम्॥
en: The fore that covers the whole world rises from water. The Danava destroying thunder was made of Dadhichi's bone.

sa: तापसैरुपनीतानि फलानि सहिता मया। ततो राजा ससचिवः फलान्यादातुमैच्छत॥
en: Empelled by Fate and the words of the Rishi, the king with his ministers desired to eat those fruits.

sa: स चापि वीरः कृतशस्त्रनिश्रमः परेण साम्नाभ्यवदत् सुयोधनम्। युधिष्ठिरस्याप्यभवत् तदा मतिन कर्णतुल्योऽस्ति धनुर्धरः क्षितौ॥
en: And that hero, (Karna), accomplished in arms also began to gratify Duryodhana with sweet speeches; and Yudhisthira was impressed with the belief that there was no warrior like Karna on earth.

sa: क्षत्ता यदब्रवीद् वाक्यं जनमध्येऽब्रुवन्निव। त्वया च स तथेत्युक्तो जानीमो न च तद् वयम्॥
en: "What Khattwa (Vidura) said to you in the midst of many people, so indistinctly as if he said nothing and what you said similarly (in reply) is not understood by us.

sa: कृश उवाच तेजस्विनस्तव पिता तथैव च तपस्विनः। शवं स्कन्धेन वहति मा शृङ्गिगवितो भव॥
en: Krisha said: O Shringi, do not be proud. Ascetic as you are and possessed of great powers, (go and see) your father who is carrying a dead body (on his shoulder),

sa: दृष्टैव भीमसेनं सा शालपोतमिवोद्गतम्। राक्षसी कामयामास रूपेणाप्रतिमं भुवि॥
en: Seeing Bhimasena who resembled a Sala tree and who was matchless in beauty, the Rakshasi was filled with desire.

sa: अहमेको नयिष्यामि त्वामद्य यमसादनम्। अद्य मद्वलनिष्पिष्टं शिरो राक्षस दीर्यताम्। कुञ्जरस्येव पादेन विनिष्पिष्टं बलीयसः॥
en: I shall singly (fight with you) and send you to day to the land of the dead. O Rakshasa, your head will be pounded to pieces, being pressed by my strength.

sa: तस्मात्संमन्त्रयामोऽद्य भुजंगानामनामयम्। यथा भवेद्धि सर्वेषां मा नः कालोऽत्यगादयम्॥
en: Therefore, let us consult today how we may secure the safety of the snakes. Let us not waste time.

sa: गन्धमादनमासाद्य बदर्यां च तपोरतः। गोकर्णे पुष्करारण्ये तथा हिमवतस्तटे॥
en: He practised his penances, going to Gandhamadana, Badari, Gokarna, the forest of Pushkara and the foot of the Himalayas.

sa: काम नैतत्प्रशंसन्ति सन्तः स्वबलसंस्तवम्। गुणसंकीर्तनं चापि स्वयमेव शतक्रतो॥
en: O Shatakratu, the learned do not approve of speaking highly of their own strength or of their own merits.

sa: अथेश्वरमुवाचेदमात्मनः सा वचो हितम्। पतिं सर्वगुणोपेतमिच्छामीति पुनः पुनः॥
en: Being desirous of benefiting herself, she again and again said to the supreme deity, "Give me an accomplished husband."

sa: एवमुक्तास्तदा गत्वा गरुडं वाग्भिरस्तुवन्। ते दूरादभ्युपेत्यैनं देवाः सर्षिगणास्तदा॥
en: Sauti said: Thus asked, the celestial went with the Rishis towards Garuda and from a distance addressed him thus.

sa: पुरास्त्रमिदमाग्नेयं प्रादात् किल बृहस्पतिः। भरद्वाजाय गन्धर्व गुरुर्मान्यः शतक्रतोः॥
en: The fire weapon that I hurl against you was formerly given by the preceptor of Indra, Brihaspati, to Bharadvaja.

sa: गन्धर्व उवाच संयोगो वे प्रीतिकरो महत्सु प्रतिदृश्यते। जीवितस्य प्रदानेन प्रीतो विद्यां ददामि ते॥
en: The Gandharva said : A meeting with an illustrious person is always a matter of gratification. Besides you have given me life. Thus being pleased with you, I give the science.

sa: ततस्तस्य समुद्रस्य तज्जातमुदकं पयः। रसोत्तमैर्विमिदं च तत: क्षीरादभूद्धृतम्॥
en: The milky water of the churned ocean by degrees produced clarified butter by virtue of those gums and juices.

sa: अवमेने च तां दृष्ट्वा सर्वलोकेषु योषितः। अवाप्तं चात्मनो मेने स राजा चक्षुषः फलम्॥
en: The sight of that maiden inspired the king with a contempt for all the women of the world that he had seen before. Seeing her, the king considered his eyes blessed.

sa: सौतिरुवाच आयुष्मन्निदमाख्यानमास्तीकं कथयामि ते। यथाश्रुतं कथयतः सकाशाद्वै पितुर्मया॥
en: Sauti said: O long-lived ones, I shall narrate this story of Astika as I heard it from my father.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स गन्धर्ववचः श्रुत्वा तत् तदा भरतर्षभ। अर्जुनः परया भक्त्या पूर्णचन्द्र इवाबभौ॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Hearing these words of the Gandharva, that best of the Bharata race, Arjuna, was filled with devotion (towards him) and he stood as manifest as the full moon.

sa: सनाम्नी चोद्यतां भार्यां गृह्णीयामिति तस्य हि। मनो निविष्टमभवज्जरत्कारोर्महात्मनः॥
en: The high-souled Jaratkaru thought within himself, “I will take none for my wife who does not bear my name."

sa: इतस्ततः परिचरन् दीप्तपावकसप्रभः। अटमानः कदाचित्स्वान् स ददर्श पितामहान्॥
en: As bright as a blazing fire, he roamed about and thus roving about, he one day saw his ancestors,

sa: ऋषिरुवाच श्रोष्यसि त्वं रुरो सर्वमास्तीकचरितं महत्। ब्राह्मणानां कथयतामित्युक्त्वान्तरधीयत॥
en: Rishi said: O Ruru, you will hear the important history of Astika from the Brahmanas. Saying this he disappeared.

sa: तां ददर्श स्वयं ब्रह्मा सर्वलोकपितामहः। रुदतीं बाष्पपूर्णाक्षी भृगोर्भार्यामनिन्दिताम्॥
en: The Grandfather of all beings, Brahma himself saw the faultless wife of Bhrigu weeping with eyes full of tears.

sa: एतत्त्रयोदशं पर्व धर्मनिश्चयकारकम्। अध्यायानां शतं त्वत्र षट्चत्वारिंशदेव तु॥
en: This is the thirteenth Parva which describe the certainty of righteousness. It contains one hundred and forty six chapters.

sa: ब्राह्मणाश्च महाभागा देशेभ्यः समुपागमन्। ततोऽर्चिता राजगणा द्रुपदेन महात्मना॥
en: There also many illustrious, Brahmanas from many countries. The kings and princes were duly worshipped by the illustrious Drupada.

sa: एतद्वैदशमं पर्व सौप्तिकं समुदाहृतम्। अष्टादशास्मिन्नध्यायाः पर्वण्युक्ता महात्मना॥ श्लोकानां कथितान्यत्र शतान्यष्टौ प्रसंख्यया। श्लोकाश्च सप्ततिः प्रोक्ता मुनिना ब्रह्मवादिना॥
en: These matters are dwelt with in this tenth Sauptika Parva. The great Vyasa composed it in eighteen chapters. The numbers of slokas composed in it by the great reciter of the sacred truths, is eight hundred and seventy.

sa: ब्राह्मणैस्ते च सहिताः पाण्डवाः समुपाविशन्। ऋद्धिं पाञ्चालराजस्य पश्यन्तस्तामनुत्तमाम्॥
en: The Pandavas sat there in the arena with the Brahmanas and saw the great affluence of the Panchala king.

sa: शल्यस्य निधनं चात्र धर्मराजान्महात्मनः। शकुनेश्च वधोऽत्रैव सहदेवेन संयुगे॥
en: Then the death of Shalya at the hands of Yudhishthira, the death of Shakuni at the hands of Sahadeva.

sa: यत्र भीमो महाबाहुः सात्यकिश्च महारथः। अन्वेषणार्थं पार्थस्य युधिष्ठिरनृपाज्ञया॥
en: Then in order to search Partha, greatly powerful Bhima and the great car-warrior Satyaki, by command of king Yudhishthira.

sa: एवं तेषु निवृत्तेषु क्षत्रियेषु समन्वतः। चेदीनामधिपो वीरो बलवानन्तकोपमः॥
en: When all those assembled Kshatriyas gave up the task, the heroic king of the Chedis as powerful as Yama,

sa: भद्रं वोऽस्तु निहितं यद् गुहायां विवर्धध्वं ज्वलना इवैधमानाः। मा वो विदुः पार्थिवाः केचिदेव यास्यावहे शिविरायैव तावत्। सोऽनुज्ञातः पाण्डवेनाव्ययश्री: प्रायाच्छीघ्रं बलदेवेन सार्धम्॥
en: Be blessed, Grow in prosperity as a fire in a cave gradually grows and spreads itself all around. Lest any of the kings recognise you, give us permission to return to our camp. Then obtaining the permission of the Pandavas, Krishna of undying prosperity, accompanied with Vasudeva, soon went away.

sa: कृतं हि तत्स्यात् सत्कृतं ममेदं यशश्च पुण्यं च हितं तदेतत्। अथोक्तवाक्यं हि पुरोहितं स्थितं ततो विनीतं समुदीक्ष्य राजा॥ समीपतो भीममिदं शशास प्रदीयतां पाद्यमर्थ्य तथास्मै। मान्यः पुरोधा द्रुपदस्य राज्ञः तस्मै प्रयोज्याभ्यधिका हि पूजा॥
en: If that has become possible, nothing could be better, nothing more beneficial and nothing more conductive to fame and virtue than that incident. Having said this, the priest became silent. The king (Yudhishthira) seeing him thus sitting with humility said, “Let water to wash his fact and the Arghya be offered to this Brahmana. He is king Drupada's priest and therefore he is worthy of our respect. We should worship him with more than ordinary reverence.”

sa: तापत्यमथ वासिष्ठमौर्वं चाख्यानमुत्तमम्। भ्रातृभिः सहितः सर्वैः पञ्चालानभितो ययौ॥
en: The accounts of Tapati, Vasishtha and Aurva; then the arrival of the Pandavas with all the brothers at Panchala;

sa: तल्लक्षयित्वा दुपदस्य पुत्रो राजा च सर्वैः सह मन्त्रिमुख्यैः। समर्थयामासुरुपेत्य हृष्टाः कुन्तीसुतान् पार्थिव राजपुत्रान्॥
en: Seeing this, Drupada's sons and the king (Drupada) himself with all the chief councillors knew the sons of Kunti to be all of royal blood and they therefore became exceedingly happy.

sa: मयस्य दर्शनं चैव आदिपर्वणि कथ्यते। पौष्ये पर्वणि महात्म्यमुत्तङ्कस्योपवर्णितम्॥
en: The meeting with Maya, these are the contents of Adi Parva. The Paushya Parva contains the greatness of Uttanka.

sa: धिगकुर्वंस्तदा भीष्मं धृतराष्ट्रं च कौरवम्। कर्मणातिनृशंसेन पुरोचनकृतेन वै॥
en: Remembering the greatly cruel dead of Purochana, they said, “Fie on Bhishma! Fie on Dhritarashtra of the Kuru race!"

sa: किमन्यद् विहिता नूनं तस्य सा पुरुषेन्द्रता। यदि ते विहितं राज्यं भविष्यति विशाम्पते॥ मिषतः सर्वलोकस्य स्थास्यते त्वयि तद् ध्रुवम्। अतोऽन्यथा चेद् विहितं यतमानो न लप्स्यसे॥
en: O king, what else human exertion can be said to have been in him than that the kingdom was dependent on his Destiny. If this kingdom be fixed in you by destiny. It will certainly remain in you, notwithstanding the enmity of all the worlds. If otherwise, however you may try, it will never remain in you.

sa: भारद्वाजो महाप्राज्ञो द्रोणः प्रियसखस्तव। समाश्लेषमुपेत्य त्वां कुशलं परिपृच्छति॥
en: The son of Bharadvaja, the greatly, wise Drona, your beloved friend, embracing you mentally, has enquired after your welfare.

sa: यदाऽभिमन्यु परिवार्य बालं सर्वे हत्वा हृष्टरूपा बभूवुः। महारथाः पार्थमशक्नुवन्त स्तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजया।१८९॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that our great car-warriors, being unable to defeat Arjuna, had enjoyed joy after jointly surrounded and slain the boy Abhimanyu.

sa: मोदापुरं वामदेवं सुदामानं सुसंकुलम्। उलूकानुत्तरांश्चैव तांश्च राज्ञः समानयत्॥
en: He then subjugated Modapura, Vamadeva, Sudamana, Susankula, the northern Ulukas and the kings and the people of those countries.

sa: चित्रकौतूहले तस्मिन् वर्तमाने महाद्भुते। वासुदेवश्च पार्थश्च सहितौ परिजग्मतुः॥
en: When that wonderful festival of great grandeur and delight was continuing, Vasudeva (Krishna) and Partha (Arjuna) went about together.

sa: अथ दीर्घस्य कालस्य राममाता यशस्विनी। पुत्रपौत्रैः परिवृता कालधर्ममुपागमत्॥
en: There upon after many years, the illustrious, Kausalyā, Rāma's mother, surrounded by her sons and grand-sons, breathed her last.

sa: ततः समुपविष्टेषु महर्षिषु महात्मसु। भविष्यदुत्तरं काव्यं जगतुस्तौ कुशीलवौ॥
en: There upon the high-souled Rșis having taken their seats Kusa and Lava began the last portion of the Uttarakāņdam.

sa: साधुकारश्च सुमहान्देवानां सहसोत्थितः। साधुसाध्विति वै सीते यस्यास्ते शीलमीदृशम्।।२१ एवं बहुविधा वाचो ह्यन्तरिक्षगताः सुराः। व्याजहुर्राष्टमनसो दृष्ट्वा सीताप्रवेशनम्॥
en: Eulogising her at that time, the celestials said: Oh! highly praiseworthy is your conduct, O Sītā. Being present in the welkin and beholding Sītā enter into the Earth, the celestials again and again eulogised her in various words.

sa: तस्मिंस्तु धरणी देवी बाहुभ्यां गृह्य मैथिलीम्। स्वागतेनाभिनन्द्यैनामासने चोपवेशयत्॥
en: Having stretched out her arms and taken Maithilī, the goddess earth welcomed her and placed her on the throne.

sa: मूलपत्रफलैः सर्वा वर्तयिष्यथ नित्यदा। स्त्रियः किंपुरुषानाम भर्तृन्समुपलप्स्यथ ॥
en: I shall give you always fruits and roots. O you females, you shall have all Kimpuruşas as your husbands.

sa: इमे हि सर्वे विष्णो त्वां निरीक्षन्ते दिवौकसः। वृत्रघातेन महता तेषां साह्यं कुरुष्व ह॥ त्वया हि नित्यशः साह्यं कृतमेषां महात्मनाम्। असह्यमिदमन्येषामगतीनां गतिर्भवान्॥
en: O Vişnu, all the deities are waiting for you; do you help them by slaying Vộtra. O you having a large mind, you are always the help of these high-souled deities. It is impossible for any one else to accomplish the present work. You are the refuge of the helpless.

sa: जरितोवाच अहं तमभिजानामि हृतं श्येनेन मूषिकम्। नास्ति वोऽत्र भयं पुत्राः क्रियतां वचनं मम॥
en: The Jarita said : I know to a certainty that the mouse has been carried away by the hawk. Therefore, O children, you have nothing to fear. Do what I say.

sa: कथमुयनेऽशक्तान् पतने च ममात्मजान्। संतप्यमाना बहुधा वाशमाना प्रधावती॥
en: She will about uttering various laminations; for my sons are incapable of flying or rising up in the air.

sa: ततोऽन्तरिक्षाद् भगवान वतीर्य पुरंदरः। मरुद्गणैर्वृतः पार्थं केशवं चेदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then Purandara (Indra), surrounded by the Marutas, came down from the sky and thus spoke to Partha and Keshava.

sa: तस्य शब्दं सुमधुरं तन्त्रीलयसमन्वितम्। श्रुत्वा रात्रिजगामाशु शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः॥
en: In sooth the high-minded Śatrughna spent the night in no time listening to that charming song set unmusical notes.

sa: तच्छूलं दीप्यमानं तु सभृत्यबलवाहनम्। भस्मीकृत्वा नृपं भूमौ लवणस्यागमत्करम्॥
en: Thereupon growing powerful the dart reduced the king with his servants and army into ashes and returned to Lavaņa.

sa: इन्द्रसेनेन सहित इन्द्रप्रस्थमगात् तदा। व्यतीत्य विविधान् देशांस्त्वरावान् क्षिप्रवाहनः॥
en: Passing quickly through various countries on (the car yoked with his swift horses, he arrived at Indraprastha with Indrasena.

sa: जामदग्न्येय रामेण क्षत्रं यदवशेषितम्। तस्मादवरजं लोके यदिदं क्षत्रसंज्ञितम्॥
en: The men now know as Kshatriyas are inferior to those Kshatriyas that exterminated by Rama, the son of Jamadagni.

sa: ऐलस्येक्ष्वाकुवंशस्य प्रकृतिं परिचक्षते। राजानः श्रेणिबद्धाश्च तथान्ये क्षत्रिया भुवि॥
en: All the numerous royal dynasties and other Kshatriyas in the world claim to be descended from Aila and Ikshaku,

sa: तथैव सर्वपञ्चाला जरासंधभयार्दिताः। स्वराज्यं सम्परित्यज्य विद्रुताः सर्वतो दिशम्॥
en: Afflicted with the fear of Jarasandha all the Panchalas have left their own Kingdoms and fled in all directions.

sa: प्राप्नुयात् स यशो दीप्तं तत्र यो विघ्नमाचरेत्। जयेद् यश्च जरासंधं स सम्रानियतं भवेत्॥
en: He, who will be able to prevent him from doing this act, will surely earn blazing fame. He, who will defeat Jarasandha, will certainly become the emperor of all the world.

sa: ततस्त्रिगर्ताः कौन्तेयं दार्वाः कोकनदास्तथा। क्षत्रिया बहवो राजन्नुपावर्तन्त सर्वशः॥
en: O king, then the Trigartas, the Danavas, the Kokanadas and various other Kshatriyas advanced against the son of Kunti.

sa: तौ परस्परशापेन देहमुत्सृज्य धार्मिकौ। अभूतां नृपविप्रर्षी वायुभूतौ तपोधनौ॥
en: Having renounced their persons both Nimi and the pious Vasiştha, having asceticism for their wealth, were metamorphosed into air.

sa: तूष्णीभूते तदा तस्मिनराजा दशरथो मुनौ। अभिवाद्य महात्मानौ पुनरायात्पुरोत्तमम्॥
en: He being silent-the great king Dasaratha, having bowed to the two high-souled ascetics, again returned to his city Ayodhyā.

sa: भ्रामयित्वा शतगुणं जानुभ्यां भरतर्षभ। बभञ्ज पृष्ठं संक्षिप्य निष्पिष्य विननाद च॥ करे गृहीत्वा चरणं द्वेधा चक्रे महाबलः॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, having thus whirled him high for one hundred times, he (Bhima) pressed his knee against his (Jarasandha's) backbone and broke his body, into two parts. (Having thus killed him), he roared aloud.

sa: वक्तव्यश्चैव नृपतिर्धर्मेण सुसमाहितः॥ यथा भ्रातृषु वर्तेथास्तथा पौरेषु नित्यदा। परमो ह्येष धर्मस्ते तस्मात्कीतिरनुत्तमा॥ यत्तु पौरजने राजन्धर्मेण समवाप्नुयात्।
en: Do you tell further-more that king established in righteousness to treat the citizens as his brothers, to acquire piety by protecting his subjects duly for this is the greatest mortality and by this may be acquired excellent fame,

sa: दग्ध्वा लङ्कामशेषेण साट्टप्राकारतोरणाम्। प्रत्यागतश्चास्य पुनर्नाम तत्र प्रकाश्य वै॥
en: And burnt the whole of Lanka with its towers, ramparts and gates and proclaimed my name there, I returned.

sa: राक्षसाश्च पिशाचाश्च पन्नगाश्च महाबलाः। भुजवेगमशक्ता मे सोढुं पन्नगसत्तम॥
en: O excellent of serpents, the exceedingly powerful Rakshasas, Pishachas and Pannagas cannot endure the force of my even arms.

sa: धनञ्जयेन गाण्डीवमक्षय्यौ च महेषुधी। लब्धान्यस्त्राणि दिव्यानि तोषयित्वा हुताशनम्॥
en: Having worshipped Hutashana (Fire) Dhananjaya (Arjuna) has obtained the Gandiva (bow), the two inexhaustible quivers and many celestial weapons.

sa: दुर्योधनश्च कर्णश्च शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः। गन्धर्वान् योधयामासुः समरे भृशविक्षताः॥
en: Duryodhana, Karna and Shakuni, the son of Subala, all fought with the Gandharvas though they were all severely wounded.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः प्रयातः कौशिक्याः पाण्डवो जनमेजय। आनुपूर्येण सर्वाणि जगामायतनान्यथ॥ स सागरं समासाद्य गङ्गायाः संगमे नृप। नदीशतानां पञ्चानां मध्ये चक्रे समाप्लवम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said: O Janmejaya, thereupon the Pandavas started from the Kaushika and went, one after the other, to all the sacred shrines. O King, going to the sea where the Ganges mingles with it, he performed the sacred ceremony of a plunge in the centre of the five hundred rivers.

sa: इदं भार्याशतं ब्रह्मन् परीक्ष्य सदृशं प्रभो। पुत्रार्थिना मया वोढं न तासां विद्यते प्रजा॥
en: O Brahmanas, O lord, with the intention of getting sons, I married all these one hundred wives after carefully examining them whether they were suitable to me. But they have none.

sa: तस्मिन्नुपरते शब्दे राधेयः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः। प्रगृह्य रुचिरं बाहुमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: The son of Radha (Karna) became out of sense from anger. Waving his well sapped arms he spoke thus.

sa: तस्मादहं विवर्णश्च दीनश्च हरिणः कृशः। अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि सातका गृहमेधिनः॥
en: Yudhishthira supports by giving thirty servant maids to each of eighty eight thousands Snataka Brahmanas who lead domestic life.

sa: एतेषु हि नरः सक्तो धर्ममुत्सृज्य वर्तते। यथायुक्तेन च कृतां क्रियां लोको न मन्यते॥
en: The man who is addicted to those vices lives by forsaking virtue. People do not consider the acts done by a person who is thus improperly engaged as of any authority.

sa: सनत्कुमार उवाच ब्रह्म क्षत्रेण सहितं क्षत्रं च ब्रह्मणा सह! संयुक्तौ दहतः शत्रून् वनानीवाग्निमारुतौ॥
en: Sanatkumara said: As (when) fire united with the wind burns down forests, so (when) a Brahmana's energy is united with that of a Kshatriya and vice versa it consumes all enemies.

sa: न चेत् स मम राजेन्द्र गृहणीयान्मधुरं वचः। पथ्यं च भरतश्रेष्ठ निगृहणीयां बलेन तम्॥
en: And if he had not accepted, O king of kings, my sweet words like medicine. O foremost of the Bharata race, I would have compelled him to accept them by force.

sa: अन्वजानात् सधर्मज्ञो मुनिर्दिव्येन चक्षुषा। पाण्डोः पुत्रान् कुरुश्रेष्ठानास्यतामिति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Knowing these Pandavas, the best of the Kurus-by his spiritual eye, that virtuous one said to them “be seated".

sa: तत्र गन्धर्वराजो वै पूर्वमेव विशाम्पते। कुबेरभवनाद् राजन्नाजगाम गणावृतः॥
en: O monarch, the king of the Gandharvas with his followers had already arrived there from the abode of Kubera.

sa: विदुर उवाच किर्मीरस्तवब्रवीदेनं दिष्ट्या देवैरिदं मम। उपपादितमोह चिरकालान्मनोगतम्॥ भीमसेनवधार्थं हि नित्यमभ्युद्यतायुधः। चराम पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां नैनं चासादयाम्यहम्॥
en: Vidura said: Kirmira replied, “By good luck, Fate has accomplished today my long cherished desire. With weapons upraised, I have been continually wandering over the earth with the object of killing Bhima. But I did not find him.

sa: अन्वगच्छंस्तथैवान्यान् क्षत्रियान् क्षत्रियर्षभाः। एवं सुपूजिताः सर्वे जग्मुर्विप्राः सहस्रशः॥
en: The other best of Kshatriyas followed others Kshatriyas; and thousands of Brahmanas also, after being duly worshipped, went away.

sa: दमयन्त्यपि कल्याणी निद्रयापहृता ततः। सहसा दुःखमासाद्य सुकुमारी तपस्विनी॥
en: Then ever used to happiness, the comcly and innocent Damayanti, too, suddenly visited with misfortune, became unconscious in sleep.

sa: कारणानां च परमं जाने त्वां त्र्यम्बकं विभुम्। देवानां च गतिं देव त्वत्प्रसूतमिदं जगत्॥
en: O three-eyed god, O lord of all, I know you to be the cause of all causes. You are the refuge of all the celestials. The universe has sprung from you.

sa: अयमादिशरीरेण देवसृष्टेन मानवः। शुभानामशुभानां च कुरुते संचयं महत्॥
en: Man by his original subtle frame, made by the creator, accumulates a great store of good and evil deeds.

sa: ऋचीकनन्दनो रामो भार्गवो रेणुकासुतः। तस्य दाशरथेः श्रुत्वा रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः॥ कौतूहलान्वितो रामस्त्वयोध्यामगमत् पुनः। धनुरादाय तद् दिव्यं क्षत्रियाणां निबर्हणम्॥
en: Being impelled by curiosity, Rama, the descendant of Bhrigu, the son of Richika and Renuka, hearing of Rama, the son of Dasharatha of spotless deeds, went to Ayodhya, taking with him the bow so fatal to the Kshatriyas.

sa: सुभद्रामभिमन्युं च रथमारोप्य काञ्चनम्। आरुरोह रथं कृष्णः पाण्डवैरभिपूजितः॥
en: Causing Subhadra and Abhimanyu to ascend his golden car, Krishna, being duly worshipped by the Pandavas, ascended it himself.

sa: अर्श्वबाहुर्विशालायां बदर्यां स नराधिप। एकपादस्थितस्तीव्र चकार सुमहत् तपः॥
en: Standing on one leg and with uplifted arms, that chief of men performed severe asceticism in the extensive Badari.

sa: गाण्डीवमुक्ता विशिखाः सम्यगस्त्रप्रचोदिताः। अच्छिन्दत्रुत्तमाङ्गानि यत्र यत्र स्म तेऽभवन्॥
en: And by means of arrows duly shot from the Gandiva, I cut off their heads wherever they were stationed.

sa: पाण्डवाश्च महात्मानस्तेषु वेश्मसु तां क्षपाम्। सुखमूषुर्गतोद्वेगा: पूजिताः सर्वराक्षसैः॥
en: The noble-minded Pandavas dwelt happily for several sights in those mansions without anxiety and honoured by all the Rakshasas,

sa: अब्राह्मणस्य सावित्री पठतस्तु प्रणश्यति। संवर्तस्य तु विप्रर्वापीमासाद्य दुर्लभाम्॥ रूपस्य भागी भवति सुभगश्च प्रजापते।
en: A man who is not a Brahmana cannot properly recite it at all. Going then to the inaccessible tank of the Brahmana Rishi Samvarta, one obtains personal beauty and great prosperity.

sa: एवंविधा: सुबहवस्तस्य यज्ञा महीपतेः। बभूवुरस्य सरसः समीपे कुरुनन्दन॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, O king, many such sacrifices of his were performed on the banks of this lake.

sa: क्षमा तेजस्विनां तेजः क्षमा ब्रह्म तपस्विनाम्। क्षमा सत्यं सत्यवतां क्षमा यज्ञः क्षमा शमः॥
en: Forgiveness is the energy of the energetic; forgiveness is the sacrifice and forgiveness is the control of mind; forgiveness is the truth of the truthful; forgiveness is the control of mind.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः सूर्योदयेधौम्यः कृत्वाऽऽछिकमरिंदम्। आर्टिषेणेन सहितः पाण्डवानभ्यवर्तत॥
en: Then, O tormentor of foes, when the sun rose, Dhaumya, on performing his devotions, visited the Pandavas, with Arstisena.

sa: कोकिलैः कलविहेच हारितैर्जीवजीविकैः। प्रियकैश्चातकैश्चैव तथान्यैर्विविधै खगैः॥ ओत्ररम्यं सुमधुरं कूजद्भिश्चात्यधिष्ठितान्। सरांसि च मनोज्ञानि समन्ताज्जलचारिभिः॥
en: Kokilas, Kalabinkas, Haritas, Jibojibakas, Priakas, Chatakas and various other birds warbling forth sweet notes pleasant to the ear. And they beheld also lakes all around looking beautiful with water birds filled.

sa: तेऽभिवाद्याष्टिषेणस्य पादौधौम्यस्य चैव ह। ततः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे ब्राह्मणांस्तानपूजयन्॥
en: Having bowed down to the feet of Dhaumya and Arstisena, they then worshipped all the Brahmanas with joined hands.

sa: निष्क्रामंश्चाप्यपश्यत् स पत्नीस्तेषां महात्मनाम्। स्वेष्वासनेषूपविष्टाः स्वपन्तीश्च तथा सुखम्॥
en: Coming out from that place, he saw the wives of those high-souled Rishis sleeping comfortably on their respective beds,

sa: वध्यमानास्ततो लोकाः सागरैर्मन्दबुद्धिभिः। ब्रह्माणं शरणं जग्मुः सहिताः सर्वदैवतैः॥
en: Persecuted by the wicked-minded sons of Sagara, all creatures with all the celestials went to ask protection from Brahma.

sa: ध्रुवं विनाशो नृप कौरवाणां न वै श्रेयोधृतराष्ट्रः परैति। यथाच पणे पुष्करस्यावसिक्तं जलं न तिष्ठेत् पथ्यमुक्तं तथास्मिन्॥
en: O king, the destruction of the Kurus is certain; Dhritarashtra will never meet with good fortune. As water dropped on a lotus leaf son does not remain there, so my counsels failed to have any effect on him.

sa: राजोवाच पग्था अयं तेऽद्य मयातिदिष्टो येनेच्छसि तेन कामं व्रजस्व। निन्द्रोऽपि नित्यं नमते ब्राह्मणानाम्॥
en: The king said : I leave the path, go in whatever way you like. Even the smallest fire is not to be slighted. Indra himself always bows down to a Brahmana.

sa: तौ जग्मतुर्मातुलभागिनेयौ यज्ञं समृद्ध जनकस्य राज्ञः। अष्टावक्रं पथि राज्ञा समेत्य प्रोत्सार्यमाणो वाक्यमिदं जगाद॥
en: Thereupon the uncle and the nephew went to the splendid sacrifice of the king Janaka. Having been driven away from the path, Ashtavakra on meeting the king thus spoke to him.

sa: दृश्यन्ते शान्तरजसः क्षपा जलदशीतलाः। ग्रहनक्षत्रसङ्घश्च सोमेन च विराजिताः॥
en: (Then) the nights free from dust and cool with clouds were adorned with numerous stars, planets and the moon.

sa: ततो ब्रह्मा महासेनं प्रजापतिरथाब्रवीत्। अभिगच्छ महादेवं पितरं त्रिपुरार्दनम्॥
en: Then Brahma, the lord of creatures, said to Mahasena, “Go and see your father Maheshvara, the chastiser of Tripura.

sa: दिव्यैश्च पुष्पैस्तं देवाः समन्तात् पर्यवारयन्। देवदुन्दुभयश्चापि नेदुः स्वयमनीरिताः॥
en: The celestials showered heaven-grown flowers upon him from the sky; as also the divine kettle-drums played spontaneously without cessation.

sa: वाक्यशूरस्य चैवास्य परुषस्य दुरात्मनः। दुःशासनस्य रुधिरं पातास्मि मृगराडिव॥
en: As regards this wicked-minded man Dushasana, who is bold in speech, I will drink his blood like a lion.

sa: इत्युक्तवा प्रययौ राजा सह क्षत्रा युधिष्ठिरः। अमृष्यमाणस्तस्याथ समाह्वानमरिंदमः॥
en: Having said this, the chastiser of foes Yudhishthira, went with Khattwa (Vidura) without deliberating over the summons (of Dhritarashtra).

sa: ततस्तुष्टौ महात्मानौ सहदेवाय वानरौ। ऊचतुश्चैव संहृष्टौ प्रीतिपूर्वमिदं वचः॥
en: Those two illustrious monkey-kings (were much) pleased with Sahadeva, and they thus joyfully spoke to him these affectionate words.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वायुर्दिव्यगन्धवहः शुचिः। सुखप्रह्लादनः शीत: पुष्पवर्षं ववर्ष च॥
en: Just as that moment the breeze became fresh, charming, cool and full of celestials fragrance and it showered flowers.

sa: येषां तथा राम समारभन्ते कार्याणि नाथाः स्वमतेन लोके। ते नाथवन्तः पुरुषप्रवीरा नानाथवत् कृच्छ्रमवाप्नुवन्ति॥
en: O Rama, those, whose help-mate sact according to their own opinion, those men having others to look after them, never meet with disaster like men who have none to help them.

sa: यदि वै वक्ष्यसि मृषा प्रह्लादाथ न वक्ष्यसि। शतधा ते शिरो वज्री वज्रेण प्रहरिष्यति॥
en: O Prahlada, if you answer falsely, or do not answer at all, your head will then be spilt into a hundred pieces by the wielder of thunder (Indra) with his thunder.

sa: वामदेव उवाच छन्दांसि वै मादृशं संवहन्ति लोकेऽमुष्मिन् पार्थिव यानि सन्ति। अस्मिन्स्तु लोके मम यानमेतदस्मद्विधानामपरेषां च राजन्॥
en: Vamadeva said : O king, the Vedas indeed carry persons like us, but that is in the next world. But in this world animals like these (horses) carry me and also men like me and also all others,

sa: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। हृष्टाः सम्पूजयामासुः पार्थमक्लिष्टकारिणम्॥
en: Thereupon the celestials, accompanied by Gandharvas, Siddhas and great Rishis, delighted, adored the son of Pritha of unwearied actions.

sa: सा दृष्ट्वा महदाश्चर्यं विस्मिता ह्यभवत् तदा। दमयन्त्यनवद्याङ्गी वीरसेननृपस्नुषा॥
en: Seeing this wondrous phenomenon, Damayanti of faultless shape and limbs and the daughter-in-law of king Virasena became greatly amazed.

sa: तत्र शुक्लाम्बरधरौ पितरावस्य पूजितौ। कृताहारौ तु संतुष्टावुपविष्टौ वरासने। धर्मव्याधस्तु तौ दृष्ट्वा पादेषु शिरसापतत्॥
en: His adorable parents, after their meal, were comfortably seated there on excellent seats, with white robes on. Seeing them the Fowler prostrated himself before them with his head at their feet.

sa: प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य ज्येष्ठस्थानं व्रजेन्नरः। अभिगम्य महादेवं विराजति यथा शशी॥
en: After walking round it a man should then to go Jyeshtasthana. Seeing Mahadeva there, one looks like the moon.

sa: समेत्य राज्ञा वृषपर्वणा ते प्रत्यर्चितास्तेन च वीतमोहाः। शशंसिरे विस्तरशः प्रवासं गिरौ यथावद् वृषपर्वणस्ते॥
en: Meeting with the king, Vrishaparva and being welcomed by him they recovered from fatigue and then they related to him) faithfully and fully the story of their stay in the mountains.

sa: आलोकयन्तो मैनाकं नानाद्विजगणायुतम्। हिरण्यशिखरं चैव तच्च बिन्दुसरः शिवम्॥
en: Seeing the Mainaka mountain with golden peaks and also the auspicious Binda lake abounding in various sorts of birds.

sa: ततः केचिन्महीपाला नाब्रुवंस्तत्र किंचन। अतीतवाक्पथे काले प्रेक्षमाणा जनार्दनम्॥
en: Some amongst those kings did not speak a word during those unspeakable moments; they sat gazing at Janardana (Krishna).

sa: तस्य मार्गादपाक्रामन् सर्वभूतानि गच्छतः। युक्तस्यैन्द्रेण योगेन पराक्रान्तस्य शुष्मिणः॥
en: All creatures left the path that the greatly energetic and powerful (hero) took with the desire of seeing Indra.

sa: सत्यं श्रेष्ठं पाण्डव विप्रलापं तुल्यं चान्नं सह भोज्यं सहायैः। आत्मा चैषामग्रतो न स्म पूज्य एवंवृत्तिवर्धते भूमिपालः॥
en: O son of Pandu, share your wealth with your adherents; behave truthfully towards them and talk with them agreeably. Share also your food with them and never boast in their presence. This conduct increases the prosperity of kings.

sa: अलक्ष्मीराविशत्येनं शयानमलसं नरम्। नि:संशयं फलं लब्ध्वा दक्षो भूतिमुपाश्नुते॥
en: Adversity overpowers a person who is idle and lies down, whereas whoever is active reaps success and enjoys prosperity.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच शृणु सत्यं वरारोहे यत् त्वां वक्ष्याम्यनिन्दिते। शृण्वन्तु मे दिशश्चैव विदिशश्च सदेवताः॥
en: Arjuna said: O beautiful lady, beauty of faultless features, hear what I truly tell you and also let the four directions and the four transverse directions and also the celestials hear.

sa: रैभ्यस्य तु सुतावास्तामर्वावसुपरावसू। आसीद् यवक्रीः पुत्रस्तु भरद्वाजस्य भारत॥
en: Raivya had two sons, named Arvavasu and Pravashu. O descendant of Bharata, Bharadvaja had only one son named Yavakrit.

sa: तमन्वियाम भवतां प्रभावाद् रजनीचराः। पुरा स नापरानोति सिद्धानां ब्रह्मवादिनाम्॥ तथेत्युक्त्वा तु ते सर्वे हैडिम्बप्रमुखास्तदा। उद्देशज्ञाः कुबेरस्य नलिन्या भरतर्षभ॥ आदाय पाण्डवांश्चैव तांश्च विप्राननेकशः। लोमशेनैव सहिताः प्रययुः प्रीतमानसाः॥
en: He will never first offend the Siddhas, learned in the Vedas." O best of the Bharata race, saying "Be it so," the son of Hidimba (Ghatotkacha) and the other Rakshasas, who knew the place where the lotus-lake of Kuber was situated, cheerfully started with Lomasha, carrying the Pandavas and many of the Brahmanas. Going with great speed, they saw the blessed forest,

sa: शकुनिरुवाच अयं मया पाण्डवानां धनुर्धरः। पराजितः पाण्डवः सव्यसाची। भीमेन राजन् दयितेन दीव्य यत् कैतवं पाण्डव तेऽवशिष्टम्॥
en: Shakuni said This foremost of all wielders of bows, this Pandava Savyasachi (Arjuna) has been won by me. O king, O Pandava play now with (staking) your beloved Bhima, the only wealth that is now left to you.

sa: तस्मिंस्तीर्थे महाबाहो स्नात्वा पापैः प्रमुच्यते। गङ्गायां तु नरः स्नात्वा ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः॥ विधूतपाप्मा भवति वाजपेयं च विन्दति।
en: O mighty-armed hero, bathing in that Tirtha one is cleansed of his sins. Bathing in the Ganges with concentrated mind and with Brahmacharya life. One is cleansed of all his sins and obtains the fruits of Vajapeya sacrifice.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच मार्कण्डेयमृषयः पाण्डवाः पर्यपृच्छन्नस्ति कश्चिद् भवतश्चिरजाततर इति॥शा
en: Vaishampayana said: The Rishis and the Pandavas again asked Markandeya, “Is there any who possesses longer life than you?”

sa: भवानस्मन्नियोगेन यातु तावन्महीतलम्। काम्यके द्रक्ष्यसे वीरं निवसन्तं युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: At my request go back to the earth. You will find the heroic Yudhishthira living in the Kamyaka (forest).

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु हनुमान् भीमसेनमभाषत। भ्रातृत्वात् सौहृदाच्चैव करिष्यामि प्रियं तव॥
en: Having been thus addressed, Hanuman then spoke to Bhimasena, "From fraternal affection and friendship, I shall do you good.”

sa: आस्था तु त्वयि मे नास्ति यतोऽसि न हतस्तदा। ब्रह्मरूपप्रतिच्छन्नो न नो वदसि चाप्रियम्॥
en: But as I had no apprehension from you, I did not kill you. You are in the disguise of a Brahmana and you did not speak towards us any harsh words.

sa: एवमेष चरन् पार्थ कालचक्रमतन्द्रितः। प्रकर्षन् सर्वभूतानि सविता परिवर्तते॥
en: Thus increasingly turning on the wheel of time and influencing all creatures, O Partha, Savita goes on his course.

sa: शिशुपाल उवाच द्विषतां नो भीष्मैष प्रभावः केशवस्य यः। यस्य संस्तववक्ता त्वं वन्दिवत् सततोत्थितः॥
en: Shishupala said O Bhishma, when always rising from your seat you are praising his like a (professional) chaunter, let our enemies possess that prowess which is possessed by this Keshava (Krishna).

sa: तत्र देवर्षिवर्येण नारदेनानुकीर्तितः। पुराणः श्रूयते श्लोकस्तं निबोध युधिष्ठिर॥
en: O Yudhishthira, the celestials Rishi Narada of great intelligence has recited an ancient sloka about it. Listen to it.

sa: त्वया झुपासिता नित्यं ब्राह्मणा भरतर्षभ। द्वैपायनप्रभृतयो नारदश्च महातपाः॥
en: O best of the Bharatas, you have always worshipped the Brahmanas of great austerities such as Dvaipayana and Narada.

sa: मानुषान्मृत्युरेतेषां निर्दिष्टो ब्रह्मणा पुरा। एतानपि रणे पार्थ कालकञ्जान् दुरासदान्। वज्रास्त्रेण नयस्वाशु विनाशं सुमहाबलान्॥
en: Formerly it was destined by Brahma that they should be killed by mortals. O Partha, (therefore) destroy speedily these invincible and exceedingly powerful Kalakanjas in battle by the weapon Vajra (thunderbolt).

sa: हिरण्यमूर्तिर्भगवानेष एव च पावकिः। सदा कुमारो देवानां सैनापत्यमवाप्तवान्॥
en: The illustrious son of Pavaka had a golden form. Indeed, Kumara is always the leader of the celestial arms.

sa: यस्यास्तु न भवेद् भ्राता पिता वा भरतर्षभ। नोपयच्छेत तां जातु पुत्रिकाधर्मिणी हि सा॥
en: That girl who has no brother nor father should not be married, O chief of Bharata's race, For she may be intended for giving birth to the heir of her father.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच दत्तानां फलसम्प्राप्तिं गवां प्रब्रूहि मेऽनघ। विस्तरेण महाबाहो न हि तृष्यामि कथ्यताम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said O sinless one, do you describe to me more fully the merits of making gifts of kine. O you of mighty arms, I am never satiated with your words.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच शुभानामशुभानां च नेह नाशोऽस्ति कर्मणाम्। प्राप्य प्राप्यानुपच्यन्ते क्षेत्रं क्षेत्र तथा तथा॥
en: The Brahmana said The acts, good and bad, that the Individual Soul, docs are not subject 10 destruction. Upon attainment of body after body, those deeds yield fruits corresponding with then.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच अश्विभ्यां सह सोमं वै न पास्यामि द्विजोत्तमा पिबन्त्वन्ये यथाकामं नाहं पातुमिहोत्सहे॥
en: Indra said I shall not, O foremost of twiceborn persons, drink Soma with the Ashvins. Let others drink with them as they please. As for mysclf, I dare not do it.

sa: मानुष्यस्तत्र सर्वा:स्म क्रियास्तस्य महात्मनः। प्रवृत्तस्त्रिदिवे राजन् दिव्याश्चैव सनातनाः॥
en: From that great kuig flowed various kinds of human acts and various kinds of celestial deeds, also, O king.

sa: ब्राह्मण्युवाच नेदमल्पात्मना शक्यं वेदितुं नाकृतात्मना। बहु चाल्पं च संक्षिप्तं विप्लुतं च मतं मम॥
en: The Brahmana's wife said This cannot be understood by a weakminded person as also by one whose soul has not been purified. My intelligence is very little, and contracted, and confused.

sa: एवं लब्ध्वा धनं मोहाद् यो हि दद्याद् न तस्य स फलं प्रेत्य भुङ्क्ते पापधनागमात्॥ यजेत वा।
en: He who, having acquired riches by such means, makes gifts or performs sacrifices therewith, never enjoys the fruits of those gifts or sacrifices in the other world on account of the wealth having been acquired by unfair means.

sa: शल्यमग्निं तथा कृत्वा पुङ्गं वैवस्वतं यमम्। वेदान् कृत्वा धनुः सर्वान् ज्यां च सावित्रिमुत्तमाम्।।
en: He made the deity of fire his shaftrced, and the SunGod's son Yama the wings of that arrow. He made the Vedas his bow and the goddess Savittri his excellent bowstring.

sa: एष धर्मो महायोगो दानं भूतदया तथा! ब्रह्मचर्ये तथा सत्यमनुक्रोशो धृतिः क्षमा॥ सनातनस्य धर्मस्य मूलमेतत् सनातनम्। श्रूयन्ते हि पुरा वृत्ता विश्वामित्रादयो नृपाः॥
en: Such gifts are fraught with virtue and equal to high austerities. Such gifts, as also mercy to all creatures, and Brahmacharya, truthfulness of speech, and kindness, and fortitude, and forgiveness, form the eternal foundations of virtue which itself is eternal. We hear of Vishvamitra and other kings of ancient times.

sa: यथाशक्त्या भगवता तदन्नं समुपार्जितम्। तस्मिन् सत्रे तु यद् वृत्तं यद् योग्यं च तदाभवत्।१०।
en: The illustrious Rishi (Agastya) acquired the food which was collected in that sacrifice and that came up to the required quantity, by lawful means according to the best of his power.

sa: सौदास उवाच त्रैलोक्ये भगवन् किंस्वित् पवित्रं कथ्यतेऽनघा यत् कीर्तयन् सदा मर्त्यः प्राप्नुयात् पुण्यमुत्तमम्॥
en: Saudasa said O holy one, O sinless one, what is that in the three worlds which is sacred and by reciting which at all times a man may win high merit?

sa: ततः संज्ञा पुनर्लध्वा स राजा बभ्रुवाहनः। मातरं तामथालोक्य रणभूमावथाब्रवीत्॥ इतो दुःखतरं किं नु यन्मे माता सुखैधिता। भूमौ निपतितं वीरमनुशेते मृतं पतिम्॥
en: King Babhruvahana then, regaining consciousness, saw his mother seated in that guise on the field of battle. Addressing her he said, What can be more painful than the sight of my mother, who has been brought up in luxury, lying on the naked Earth beside her heroic husband stretched thereon.

sa: एकैव हि भवेद् भार्या वैश्यस्य कुरुनन्दन। द्वितीया तु भवेच्छूद्रा न तु दृष्टान्ततः स्मृता॥
en: The Vaishya can take only one wife. He can take a second wife from the Shudra caste. Such is the practice, no doubt, but it is not sanctioned by the scriptures.

sa: इच्छाम त्वां वयं ज्ञातुं कात्वं क्व च गामिष्यसि। तत्त्वेन वरवर्णाभे सर्वमेतद् ब्रवीहि नः॥
en: We wish to know who you are. Who indeed, are you? Where will you proceed? O vou of very great beauty, do tell us in detail all We wish to know!

sa: युयुत्सुश्चपि कौरव्य प्रेक्षकास्त्वितरेऽभवन्॥ युधिष्ठिरच गाङ्गेयं विदुरश्च महामतिः। छादयामासतुरुभौ क्षौमैर्माल्यैश्च कौरवम्॥ धारयामास तस्याथ युयुत्सुच्छत्रमुत्तमम्।
en: Yuyutsu and others stood as spectators of the preparations. Then Yudhishthira and the great Vidura wrapped Bhishma body with silken cloth and floral garlands. Yuyutsu held an excellent uinbrella over it.

sa: समाश्वास्य तु राजानं धर्मात्मानं युधिष्ठिरम्। नारदोऽप्यगमद् राजन् परमर्षिर्यथेप्सितम्॥
en: FINISH AHSRAN The great Rishi Narada, having comforted king Yudhishthira of righteous soul, went away to where he liked.

sa: सर्वैरपि गुणैर्विद्वान् व्यतिषक्तो न लिप्यते। जलबिन्दुर्यथा लोलः पद्मिनीपत्रसंस्थितः॥
en: He lives in everything alike, and walks with knowledge. He always enjoys Nature as a lotus leaf (enjoys) water.

sa: एवमुक्तः स राजा तु भगदत्तात्मजस्तदा। तथेत्येवाब्रवीद वाक्यं पाण्डवेनाभिनिर्जितः॥
en: Thus addressed by Arjuna the royal son of Bhagadatta, defeated by the son of Pandu, said, 'So be it.'

sa: स हयं पाण्डुपुत्रस्य विषयान्तमुपागतम्। युयुधे भरतश्रेष्ठ वज्रदत्तो महीपतिः॥
en: King Vajradata, O chief of the Bharatas, finding the (sacrificial) horse arrived within his kingdom, fought (for detaining it).

sa: तस्मात् प्रसादं भगवन् कर्तुमर्हसि नः प्रभो। न देव्यां सम्भवेत् पुत्रो भवतः सुरसत्तम। धैर्यादेव निगृह्णीष्व तेजो ज्वलितमुत्तमम्॥
en: You should, O powerful one, show us favour, O illustrious deity. That favour consists in your not begetting a son, O foremost of the celestials, upon the goddess Uma. Do you, patiently govern your fiery and powerful energy.

sa: एवमुक्तः स कौरव्य देवराज्ञा बृहस्पतिः। मुहूर्तमिव संचिन्त्य देवराजानमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thus addressed by the king of the Brihaspati, thinking for a mc.nent, replied to the king of the celestials.

sa: जारासंधिभगदत्तो जलसंधश्च वीर्यवान्। भूरिश्रवाः शलः शल्यो वृषसेनश्च सानुजः॥
en: There the of Jarasandha, Bhagadatta, Jarasandha Jarasandha of great energy, Bhurishravas, Shala, Shalya and Vrishasena with his younger brother.

sa: पृच्छेत् त्वां यदि केनाहं तवाख्यात इति स्म ह। ब्रूयास्त्वं नारदेनेति संवर्त कथितोऽसि मे॥
en: And if he acquire of you as to the person who has given you the information about his own self, do you tell him that Narada has informed you about Samvarta.

sa: गावोऽधिकास्तपस्विभ्यो यस्मात् सर्वेभ्य एव च।।३७ तस्मान्महेश्वरो देवस्तपस्ताभिः सहास्थितः।
en: Kine are considered as superior to all the ascetics. And therefore, the divine Mahadeva practised penances in their company.

sa: प्राणी धर्मसमायुक्तो गच्छेत् स्वर्गगतिं पराम्॥ तथैवाधर्मसंयुक्तो नरकं चोपपद्यते।
en: A virtuous man would acquire that high end which is formed by Heaven. If sinful he goes to hell.

sa: अवश्यमेव संग्रामे क्षत्रियेण विशेषतः॥ कर्तव्यं निधनं काले मर्तव्यं क्षत्रबन्धुना। तैरियं पुरुषव्याप्रैर्विद्याबाहुबलान्वितैः॥ पृथिवी निहता सर्वा सहया सरथद्विपा।
