en: Forsooth, by Kshatriyas in particular, should enemies be killed and death encountered in battle. By those foremost of men, gifted with science and might of arms, the Earth has been exterminaled with her horses and cars and elephants.

sa: किंचिद् धर्मं प्रवक्ष्यामि चित्रगुप्तमतं शुभम्। पानीयं चैव दीपं च दातव्यं सतलं तथा॥ उपानहौ च च्छत्रं च कपिला च यथातथम्। पुष्करे कपिला देया ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे॥
en: I shall now tell you of some auspicious duties that are approved of by Chitragupta. Water for drink, and lamps for lighting darkness, should always be given as also sandals and umbrellas and Kapila kine with due rites. In Pushkara especially, one should make the gift of a Kapila cow to a Brahmana conversant with the Vedas.

sa: मरुत उवाच संवर्गोऽयं याजयिता द्विजो मां बृहस्पतेरञ्जलिरेष तस्य। न चैवासौ याजयित्वा महेन्द्र मर्यं सन्तं याजयन्नद्य शोभेत्॥
en: Marutta said This twice-born Brahmana Samvarta will perform your sacrifice, and I pray to Brihaspati, that he having acted as priest to Mahendra it does not appear well for him now to act as priest to mortal men.

sa: तेषामपि यथान्यायं पूजां चक्रे महातपाः। धृतराष्ट्राभ्यनुज्ञातः कुरुराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Gifted with severe penances, the Kuru king Yudhishthira, with the permission of Dhritarasthra, adored them according to due rites.

sa: शतमेतत् समाम्नतं शतरुद्रे महात्मनाम्। अंशो भगश्च मित्रश्च वरुणश्च जलेश्वरः॥ तथा धार्तायमा चैव जयन्तो भास्करस्तथा। त्वष्टा पूषा तथैवेन्द्रो द्वादशो विष्णुरुच्यते॥ इत्येते द्वादशादित्याः काश्यपेया इति श्रुतिः।
en: These eleven highsouled ones have been mentioned as a hundred in the Shatarudra (of the Vedas). Angsha, Bhaga, Mitra, Varuna the lord of waters, Dhatri, Aryaman, Jayanta, Bhaskara, Tvashtri, Pushan, Indra, and Vishnu, are said to comprise a tale of twelve. These twelve are called Adityas and they are the sons of Kashyapa as the Shruti declares.

sa: उवाचेदं मानुषा ये च दिव्याः प्रजापतेर्ये च लोका महान्तः। तांश्चेल्लभेयं संविदं तेन कृत्वा तथापि नेच्छेयमिति प्रतीतः॥
en: And he also observed that he did not wish to attain the worldly and the heavenly regions, and all the highest regions of Prajapati, and that if he were so minded, he would accept the terms of Indra.

sa: वनवासे च कौरव्यः कियन्तं कालमच्युतः। युधिष्ठिरो नरपति→वसत् सजनस्तदा॥
en: For how many days did the Kuru king Yudhishthira of Undecaying glory, stay with his men in the forest.

sa: भरद्वाज उवाच उत्पन्नस्य रुरोः शृङ्गं वर्धमानस्य वर्धते। प्रार्थना पुरुषस्येव तस्य मात्रा न विद्यते॥
en: Bharadvaja said The horns of a Ruru, when they first appear, begin to grow with the growth of the animal. The cupidity of man is like this. It has no limit.

sa: भीमश्च सर्वदुःख नि संस्मृत्य बहुलान्युत। कृच्छ्रादिव महाबाहुरनुजज्ञे विनिःश्वसन्॥
en: Bhima, however, of mighty-arins, recollecting all his numberless sorrows has with difficulty given his consent, breathing many heavy sighs.

sa: पूर्वं दत्त्वा तु यः कन्यां द्वितीये दातुमिच्छति। सोऽपि राजन् मृतो जन्तुः कृमियोनौ प्रजायते॥
en: Having once bestowed his daughter in marriage upon a person, he who seeks to bestow her again upon a second husband, is compelled, O king, to take birth among vile worms.

sa: वायुर्वेगेन महता रथस्य पुरतो ववौ। कुर्वत्रिःशर्करं मागं विरजस्कमकण्टकम्॥
en: The wind blew with great force before the car, clearing the path of sand grains and dust and thorns.

sa: भीष्म उवाच केन ते च भवेत् प्रीतिः कथं तुष्टिं तु गच्छसि। इति पृष्टः सुरेन्द्रेण प्रोवाच हरिरीश्वरः॥
en: Bhishma said The king of the celestials viz., Indra after the Pitris had ceased to speak addressed the powerful Hari, saying, O Lord what are those deeds which please you? How indeed do men succeed in pleasing you?

sa: यत्र नैव शरैः कार्यं न भृत्यैर्न च बन्धुभिः। आत्मनैकेन योद्धव्यं तत् ते युद्धमुपस्थितम्॥
en: In this war there will be no need for any weapons nor for friends nor attendants. The battle which is to be fought alone and singlehanded has now arrived for you.

sa: वाणीवादाञ्छुकांश्चैव सारिकान् भृङ्कराजकान्। कोकिलाञ्छतपत्रांश्च सकोयष्टिककुक्कुभान्॥ मयूरान् कुक्कुटांश्चापि दात्यूहान् जीवजीवकान्। चकोरान् वानरान् हंसान् सारसांश्चक्रसाह्वयान्॥
en: And there were talking parrots, she-parrots, Bhringarajas, Kokilas, Shatapatras with Koyashtikas and Kukkubhas, and peacocks and cocks and Datyuhas and Jivajivakas and Chakoras and monkeys and swans and Sarasas and Chakravakas.

sa: बृहस्पतेर्भगवतः पूष्णाश्चैव भगस्य च। अश्विनोश्चैव बढेश्च प्रीतिर्भवति सर्पिषा॥
en: Clarified butter is said to please the illustrious Brihaspati, Pushan, Bhaga, the twin Ashvins, and the god of fire.

sa: ततस्ते बाष्पमुत्सृज्य गान्धारीसहितं नृपम्। उपतस्थुर्महात्मानो मातरं च यथाविधि॥
en: Shedding tears, those great princes, with due formalities, approached the old king and Gandhari, as also their own mother.

sa: देवा ऊचुः भगवन् कृतकार्याः स्म यक्ष्महे स्वाप्तदक्षिणैः॥ इमं तु देशं मुनयः पर्युपासन्ति नित्यदा।
en: The gods said Our wishes, O holy one, have become successful. We shall celebrate our sacrifice even here with large gifts. Let, however, the ascetics always worship this piece of Earth.

sa: निःशब्दमभवच्चापि गङ्गाकूलं पुनर्नृप॥ कुशवल्मीकभूयिष्ठं बभूव च यथा पुरा।
en: The bank of Ganga became as silent as usual, and appeared as before covers with Kusha grass and anthills.

sa: व्यास उवाच अर्चितोऽहं त्वया राजन् वाग्भिरद्य यदृच्छया। अद्य ते कीटतां प्राप्य स्मृतिर्जाता जुगुप्सिता॥
en: Vyasa said I have today been adored by you, O king, with various words expressive of respect. Changed into a worm your memory had become clouded. That memory has again appeared.

sa: युयुत्सुश्च महातेजा धौम्यश्चैव पुरोहितः। युधिष्ठिरस्य वचनात् पुरगुप्ति प्रचक्रतुः॥
en: Yuyutsu of great energy, and Dhaumya, the priest, at the command of Yudhishthira, were engaged in protecting the city.

sa: रथान् मे बहुसाहस्रान् दिव्यैरस्त्रैर्महाबलः। घातयत्यनिशं भीष्मः प्रवराणां प्रहारिणाम्॥
en: The mighty Bhishma continuously kills with his celestial weapons many thousands of my car-warriors who are foremost of heroes.

sa: अक्षौहिण्यो दशैका च मदीयास्तव रक्षणे। यत्ता योत्स्यन्ति मा भैस्त्वं सैन्धव व्येतु ते भयम्॥
en: These ten and one Akshouhini of my troops shall strive their best for protecting you. Be not afraid, O ruler of the Sindhus. Let fear be driven away from your heart.

sa: अभिमन्युं विनिर्भिद्य प्राविशन्त धरातलम्। तथैवार्जुनिना मुक्ताः शराः कनकभूषणाः॥
en: Piercing through Abhimanyu, penetrated the surface of the earth. So also, gold-decked arrows shot by the son of Arjuna,

sa: तेऽवतीर्य कुरुक्षेत्रं पाण्डवाः सहसोमकाः। कौरवाः समवर्तन्त जिगीषन्तो महाबलाः॥
en: Arriving at Kurukshetra, the powerful Pandavas, accompanied with the Somakas, advanced against the Kurus with the desire of victory.

sa: रथैरनेकसाहस्रैः समन्तात् पर्यवारयत्। ततः प्रववृते युद्धमर्जुनस्य परैः सह॥
en: Surrounded them on all sides with many thousand chariots. Then ensured a fierce battle between Arjuna and his opponents.

sa: तत्रस्थं तवां न संसोढुं शक्ता देवाः सवासवाः। किं पुनः पाण्डवाः सर्वे सामश्वसिहि सैन्धव॥
en: There even the very gods led by Vasava himself will not be able to assault you what to speak of the sons of Pandu? Take heart, O ruler of the Sindhus."

sa: कथमेनं महात्मानं शक्ष्यामः प्रतिवीक्षितुम्। लेलिह्यमानं सैन्यं मे हविष्मन्तमिवानलम्॥
en: How shall we even look at that illustrious one who is consuming my troops like fire fed with Ghee..

sa: भीमोऽपि नागगात्रेभ्यो विनिःसृत्यापयाज्जवात्। ततः सर्वस्य सैन्यस्य नादः समभवनमहान्॥
en: Bhima issuing out from under the body of the elephant, ran away with speed. Thereupon cry in whole army.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा हतं मत्वा वृकोदरम्॥ भगदत्तं सपाञ्चाल्यः
en: Thereupon, considering Vrikodara to be slain, king Yudhishthira assisted by the Panchalas, environed Bhagadatta on all sides. a loud

sa: दुर्मुखस्य तु भल्लेन सर्वावरणभेदिना। जहार सारथेः कायाच्छिरः संनतपर्वणा॥
en: With one broad-headed and straight arrow capable of penetrating every thing, he cut off the head of Durmukha's charioteer.

sa: मयाध्यक्षेण प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम्। हेतुनानेन कौन्तेय जगद् विपरिवर्तते॥
en: Through Me, the supervisor, primal Nature produces all movable and unmovable. Thus, O son of Kunti, the universe revolves.

sa: घटोत्कचो महाराज क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः। उद्यतां तां महाशक्तिं तस्मिश्चिक्षेप वारणे॥
en: Ghatotkacha, O mighty monarch, with eyes coppery in anger, sped that raised dare of great fierceness at the elephant.

sa: कुमारं शितिपादास्तु रुक्मचित्रैरुरच्छदैः। सौचित्तिमवहन् युद्धे यन्तुः प्रेष्यकरा हयाः॥
en: Steeds, having black legs, caparisoned with golden breast-plates and obedient to the driver, bore to battle, the youthful Sauchithi.

sa: ततो बर्हिणवाजनामयुतान्यर्बुदानि च। धनंजयरथे तूर्णं पातयन्ति स्म भूमिपाः॥
en: Thereupon, the rulers of earth quickly began to pour on the car of Dhananjaya thousands and thousands of arrows.

sa: सात्यकोऽपि महाराज शरजालं निहत्य तत्। द्रौणिमभ्यकिरत् तूर्णं शरजालैरनेकधा॥
en: Satyki also, O mighty monarch, destroying that net-work of arrows, speedily scattered on Drona's a large number of arrows.

sa: अथाब्रवीद् भीमसेनं सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः। प्रहर्षयन् यदुव्याघ्रो धृष्टद्युम्नस्य पश्यतः॥
en: That foremost of the Yadus, that irresistible hero Satyaki then thus spoke to Bhimasena in the presence of Dhrishtadyumna.

sa: स तत्र गत्वा शैनेयो जवेन जयतां वरः। पार्थपार्षतयोः पाणिं जग्राह पुरुषर्षभः॥ दूरात् सात्यकि
en: The foremost of men, the descendant of (Shini), that best of all warriors (Satyaki) also soon came to the spot and defended the wings of both Bhima and the Prishata prince.

sa: ते सेने भृशसंविग्ने ययतुः स्वं निवेशनम्॥ ततः स्वशिबिरं गत्वा न्यविशंस्तत्र भारत। पाण्डवाः संजयैः सार्धं कुरवश्च यथाविधि॥
en: The troops, overwhelmed as they were with great apprehension, retired to their respective encampments. There after repairing to their respective camps. O Bharata, the Pandava along with the Srinjayas, as also the Kurus, duly rested (for the night).

sa: मामेव विशिस्त्रैस्तीक्ष्णैरभिद्रया, दंशितः। अमङ्गल्यध्वजे तस्मिन् स्त्रीपूर्वं च विशेषतः॥
en: Let the heroic Arjuna clad in mail placing Shikhandin in front of him assail me with exceedingly sharp shafts

sa: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा त्वरमाणो महारथः। सेनामचोदयत् क्षिप्रं रथनागाश्वसंकुलाम्॥
en: Then that mighty car-warrior namely Duryodhana himself in all haste urged on his army teeming with chariots and elephant.

sa: दुर्योधनस्तु शिबिरं कारयामास भारत। यथैव हास्तिनपुरं द्वितीयं समलंकृतम्॥
en: And Duryodhana caused his camp to be so made, O Bharata, as to look like a second Hastinapur, well-ornamented.

sa: ते वध्यमाना द्रोणेन वासवेनेव दानवाः॥ पञ्चाला: समकम्पन्त धृष्टद्युम्नपुरोगमाः।
en: The Panchalas having Dhrishtadyumna at their head being slaughtered by Drona, like the Danavas by Vasava, began to quake.

sa: प्रेषिता भीमसेनेन शरास्ते दृढधन्वना। अपातयन्त पुत्रांस्ते रथेभ्यः सुमहारथान्॥
en: These arrows sped by that firm bowman Bhimasena began to overthrow your sons, all mighty car-warriors, from their seats.

sa: अभिमन्युस्तु राजानमम्बष्ठं लोकविश्रुतम्। विरथं रथिनां श्रेष्ठं वारयामास सायकैः॥
en: Then Abhimanyu with his shafts, deprived that foremost of car-warriors, viz., king Ambashta of world-wide fame, of his car.

sa: तानुवाच महाप्राज्ञो वासुदेवो महामनाः। अभिप्रायोऽस्य विज्ञातो मयेति प्रहसन्निर॥
en: To them then the high-souled and the greatly wise Vasudeva thus smilingly spoke "His intention is known to me".

sa: न संख्यानं परीमाणं न तेजो न पराक्रमम्। न बलं योगयोगीश जानीमस्ते न सम्भवम्॥
en: O you that are the Lord of Yoga and the Yogins, we know neither your extent nor your measure, neither your energy nor your prowess, nor your strength, nor your origin.

sa: तस्याभिमन्युर्दशभिर्हयान् सूतं ध्वजं शरैः॥ बाहू धनुः शिश्चौा स्मयमानोभ्यपातयत्।
en: Then with ten arrows Abhimanyu smilingly cut down to the earth, his charioteer, horses, standards, arms, bow and head.

sa: गजानीकेन भीमस्य ताववारयतां दिशः। भूरिश्रवाः शलश्चैव सौबलश्च विशाम्पते॥
en: With mighty elephant division, surrounded Bhima on all directions. Also, O ruler of men, Bhurishravas, Sala and Subala's son,

sa: स शल्यमभिवाद्याथ कृत्वा चाभिप्रदक्षिणम्। उवाच राजा दुर्धर्शमात्मनिःश्रेयसं वचः॥
en: Bowing to Shalya and walking round him, the king spoke to that invincible warrior these words beneficial to him.

sa: चित्रसेनरथं राजन्नारुरोह त्वरान्वितः॥ अत्यद्भुतं रणे कर्म कृतवांस्तत्र पाण्डवः।
en: Speedily ascended, o king, the chariot of Chitrasena. Then that son of Pandu achieved marvelous feats in that battle,

sa: तमायान्तमभिक्रुद्धं द्रोणं दृष्ट्वा युधिष्ठिरः। बहुधा चिन्तयामास द्रोणस्य प्रतिवारणम्॥
en: Beholding then the infuriate Drona rush towards himself, king Yudhishthira reflected upon the diverse measures for resisting the former.

sa: बिभेद च सुसंरब्धः पुनश्चैनान् सुसंशितैः। शरैर्बहुविधाकारैः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Then again, waxing worth, he pierced them with arrows duly-whetted, of diverse shapes, and discharged by hundreds and thousands.

sa: तथा भीष्मस्तु सुदृढं वासुदेवधनंजयौ। विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैः सर्वगात्रेषु भारत॥
en: Then, O sire, Bhishma with great force pierced both Vasudeva and Dhananjaya with keen arrows all over their bodies.

sa: अपातयं शरैर्दीप्तैः प्रहसन् भरतर्षभ। तेषामापततां चित्रान् ध्वजान् हेमपरिष्कृतान्॥
en: By blazing arrows did I laughingly fell down their diverse banners ornamented with gold, O best among the Bharatas.

sa: द्रौपदेयाश्च संरब्धाः शैशुपालिश्च वीर्यवान्। केकयाश्च महावीर्याः सृञ्जयाश्च सहस्रशः॥
en: The wrathful sons of Draupadi, the valiant son of Shishupala, the highly powerful Kekayas and the Srinjayas by thousands,

sa: किमर्थे च विषादस्ते तद् ब्रूहि द्विपदां वर। न शोच्यं विदुषां श्रेष्ठ शोकः कार्यविनाशनः॥
en: Tell me, O foremost of men. the cause of this your sorrow? O foremost of the learned, sorrow should not be indulged in, inasmuch as it overthrows the ends of life.

sa: ग्रीवायं शूरसेनश्च तव पुत्रश्च मारिष। दुर्योधनो महाराज राजभिर्बहुभिर्वृतः॥
en: Shurasena and your son Duryodhana, O Bharata, surrounded by numerous kings, was stationed in its neck, O mighty sovereign.

sa: ततस्ते विस्मयं जग्मुर्नानाजनपदेश्वराः॥ स्थितिं धर्मे परां दृष्ट्वा भीष्मस्यामिततेजसः।
en: Then the rulers of the various countries, beholding the religious firmness of Bhishma of infinite prowess, were greatly amazed.

sa: सोऽभिवीक्ष्य नरौघाणां स्थानमप्रतिमं महत्। व्यूढप्रहरणोरस्कं सैन्यं तत् समबृंहयत्॥
en: Beholding that matchless and extensive encampment of the innumerable army, Karna encouraged that host of well-accoutered and broad-chested soldiers.

sa: संजातरुधिरोत्पीडो द्रौणिः क्रोधसमन्वितः। स विस्फार्य धनुश्चित्रमिन्द्राशनिसमस्वनम्॥ विव्याध दानवम्।
en: Drona's son, shedding blood profusely became possessed with wrath; then drawing his wonderful bow whose twang resembled Indra's thunder,

sa: तत्र साक्षात् पशुपतिर्दिव्यैर्भूतैः समावृतः। उमासहायो भगवान् रमते भूतभावनः॥
en: There sports the illustrious Pashupati, the creator of all things, surrounded by his celestial attendants and accompanied by Uma.

sa: अब्रवीच्च विशुद्धात्मा नाहं हन्यां शिखण्डिनम्। श्रूयते स्त्रो ह्यसौ पूर्वं तस्माद् वयॊ रणे मम॥
en: That pure souled warrior (Bhishma) has said, "I shall not kill Shikhandin. I have heard he was a woman before. For this reason he should be renounced by me in battle”.

sa: विशोकस्य वचः श्रुत्वा धृष्टद्युम्नोऽथ पार्षतः। प्रत्युवाच ततः सूतं रणमध्ये महाबलः॥ न हि मे जीवितेनापि विद्यतेऽद्य प्रयोजनम्। भीमसेनं रणे हित्वा स्नेहमुत्सृज्य पाण्डवैः॥
en: Listening to these words of Vishoka Dhrishtadyumna the son of Prishata, possess of great strength, replied to the charioteer on the filed of battle saying: If today, discarding my affection for the Pandavas, I am to abandon Bhimasena in the fight, what needs have I then of my very life?

sa: नाराचनिहतास्त्वन्ये तथा विद्धाश्च तोमरैः। विनदन्तोऽभ्यधावन्त विशृंगा इव पर्वताः॥
en: Others, slain with lances and pierced with Tomaras, with their riders killed, looked like mountains deprived of their crests.

sa: अत्यजन्नुत्तमाङ्गानि फलानीव महाद्रुमाः। ससादिनो हया राजंस्तत्र तत्र निषूदिताः॥
en: Began to drop their heads like mighty trees dropping the fruits. Slain on all sides, horse with their riders.

sa: केषां जघन्यौ सोमसूर्यो सवायू केषां सेनां श्वापदाश्चाभषन्त। केषां यूनां मुखवर्णाः प्रसन्नाः सर्वं ह्येतद् ब्रूहि मेवं यथावत्॥
en: To which side were the sun, the moons and the wind adverse? Against whom did the beasts of prey utter inauspicious sounds? Who were those young heroes whose countenances were ever cheerful? Tell me all this in detail.

sa: यस्तु शूरतमो राजन्नुभयोः सेनयोर्मत:। तं पटच्चहन्तारं लक्ष्मणः समवारयत्॥
en: Lakshmana checked that slayer slayer of Patachara who is regarded, O king, as the bravest aniong the two hosts.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु शर्वेण सिन्धुराजो जयद्रथः। उवाच प्रणतो रुद्रं प्राञ्जलिर्नियतात्मवान्॥
en: Thus spoken to by Sharva (Mahadeva), king Jayadratha bowing down to him with folded palms and subdued soul, said-

sa: भीमसेनस्तु संक्रुद्धौ गदामुद्यम्य भारत। दुर्योधनमुखान् सर्वान् पुत्रांस्ते पर्यवारयत्॥
en: Then, O Bharata, Bhimasena wrought up with wrath, with his upraised mace, opposed your sons headed by Duryodnana himself.

sa: दुर्मुस्वस्तु महेष्वासो वीरं पुरुजितं बली। द्रोणायाभिमुखं यान्तं वत्सदन्तैरवारयत्॥
en: The mighty bowman Durmukha endued with prowess, resisted with shafts called Vatsadantas, the heroic Purujit was rushing at Drona.

sa: पादाताश्च पदात्यौटुस्ताडिताः शक्तितोमरैः। न्यपतन्त तदा भूमौ शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Foot-soldiers struck by other foot soldiers with lances and dares, fell down on the ground by hundreds and thousands.

sa: संजय उवाच परिणाम्य निशां तां तु सुखं प्राप्ता जनेश्वराः। कुरवः पाण्डवाश्चैव पुनर्युद्धाय निर्ययुः॥
en: Sanjaya said Having passed that night and having enjoying a peaceful slumber, those rulers of men belonging to the hosts of the Kurus and the Pandavas, again marched out for battle.

sa: एष ते कवचं राजंस्तथा बजामि काञ्चनम्। यथा न बाणा नास्त्राणि प्रहरिष्यन्ति ते रणे॥
en: This golden coat of mail of yours, O king, I shall so tie on you that all weapons discharged by human hands will not be able to pierce you in battle.

sa: ततो द्रोणो महाराज मागधश्च महारथः। दुर्योधनसमादिष्टौ तं देशमुपजग्मतुः॥
en: Then, O monarch, Drona and the king of the Magadhas, both being commanded by Duryodhana, hide to that spot,

sa: विनिवर्त्य ततो रुक्मी सेनां सागरसंनिभाम्। दुर्योधनमुपागच्छत् तथैव भरतर्षभ॥
en: Then Rukmi, returning with that army resembling these came to Duryodhana and spoke in the same strain, O Bharata.

sa: संजय उवाच द्रौपदीहरणे यत् तद भीमसेनेन निर्जितः। मानात् स तप्तवान् राजा वरार्थी सुमहत्तपः॥
en: Sanjaya said On the occasion of the abduction of Draupadi, Jayadratha was humiliated by Bhimasena. Out of a feeling of this humiliation, the king performed rigid austerities for securing desirable boons.

sa: कथं शान्तनवं दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवानामनीकिनी। प्रहर्तुमशकत् तत्र भीष्म भीमपराक्रमम्॥
en: Seeing the son of Shantanu, Bhishma, of fearful prowess, how could the army of the Panchalas strike him down?

sa: अर्जुन उवाच सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये रथं स्थापय मेऽच्युत॥ यावदेतान् निरीक्षेऽहं योद्धकामानवस्थितान्। कैर्मया सह योद्धव्यमस्मिन् रणसमुद्यमे॥
en: "O undeteriorating one, place my car between the two armies. While I see those who stand here desirous of battle, and with whom I shall have to fight in this war-struggle.

sa: तस्माद् यस्य महाबाहो निगृहीतानि सर्वशः। इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता॥
en: Therefore, O mighty armed, his mind is steady whose senses are brought under control from all objects of senses.

sa: पुत्राणां च पराभावं श्रुत्वा संजय सर्वशः। चिन्ता मे महती सूत भविष्यति कथं त्विति॥
en: Hearing also of the humiliation of my sons in every way. O Sanjaya, I have been seized by a burning anxiety as to what the finale (of this war) will be.

sa: उद्धरिष्यामि ते सद्य: सामात्यसुतबान्धवम्। तदुपालम्भसंयुक्तं श्रावितः किल पार्थिवः॥
en: I will forthwith slay your ministers, offspring and friends. The king having heard this, the result of that insult,

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्य वीर्येण कृष्णस्य चरितेन च। कर्मभिर्भीमसेनस्य सदृशो भीमकर्मणः॥
en: Abhimanyu was equal to Yudhishthira in patience, to Krishna in conduct, to Bhima of terrible deeds in his achievements.

sa: सोऽपविद्ध्य धनुश्छिन्नं पुत्रस्ते क्रोधमूर्छितः। अन्यत् कार्मुकमादत्त सत्वरं वेगवत्तरम्॥
en: Thereat your son overwhelmed with fury, throwing off that severed bow, swiftly took up another bow of tougher make.

sa: वियद् द्यां पृथिवीं चैव तथा विष्णुपदं व्रजन्। विस्मितः सह कृष्णोन क्षिप्तो बाण इवाभ्यगात्॥
en: Then wandering through the sky the firmament and the earth, he arrived at Vishnupada; there struck with admiration and like an arrow shot from the bow, he came down with Krishna.

sa: नकुलः सहदेवश्च धर्मराजश्च वीर्यवान्। तथेतराणि सैन्यानि सर्वाण्येव विशाम्पते॥
en: Nakula, and Sahadeva, and the highly powerful Dharmaraja Yudhishthira, as also the other inferior soldiers, O ruler of men,

sa: चक्ररक्षौ तु भीमस्य माद्रीपुत्रौ महाद्युती। द्रौपदेयाः ससौभद्राः पृष्ठगोपास्तरस्विनः॥ धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पाञ्चाल्यस्तेषां गोप्ता महारथः। सहितः पृतनाशूरै रथमुख्यैः प्रभद्रकैः॥ शिखण्डी तु ततः पश्चादर्जुनेनाभिरक्षितः। यत्तो भीष्मविनाशाय प्रययौ भरतर्षभ॥
en: The greatly effulgent twin sons of Madri (Nakula and Sahadeva) became the protectors of Bhima's chariot. The sons of Draupadi and the son of Subhadra, all possessing great heroism, protected him from behind. Behind him stood Shikhandin, who was protected by Arjuna. O best of the Bharata race, he advanced with the firm determination to kill Bhishma.

sa: अब्रवीच्च विशुद्धात्मा नाहं हन्यां शिखण्डिनम्। श्रूयते स्त्रो ह्यसौ पूर्वं तस्माद् वयॊ रणे मम॥
en: That pure souled warrior (Bhishma) has said, "I shall not kill Shikhandin. I have heard he was a woman before. For this reason he should be renounced by me in battle”.

sa: नक्षत्रैरर्धचन्दैश्च शातकुम्भमयैश्चितम्। कालिङ्गस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो धनुामवमृज्य च॥ प्रगृह्य च शरं घोरमेकं सर्पविषोपमम्। प्राहिणोद् भीमसेनाय वधाकाङ्क्षी जनेश्वरः॥
en: It was adorned with stars and crescents made of gold. The Kalinga king also in great anger rubbed his bow string and took up a poisoned Shakti. He shot it at Bhimasena with the desire of killing him.

sa: तास्तवेह पुनः क्रोधात् प्रजा दह्यन्ति सर्वशः। ता दृष्ट्वा मम कारुण्यं प्रसीद भगवन् प्रभो॥
en: Those very creatures are now being burnt down by the fire of your anger. Seeing their condition, I am filled with compassion; O Lord, O illustrious One, be merciful on them.

sa: द्रवते च महासैन्यं पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः। एते च कौरवास्तूर्णं प्रभग्नान् वीक्ष्य सोमकान्॥ प्राद्रवन्ति रणे दृष्ट्वा हर्षयन्तः पितामहम्। सोऽहं भीष्मं निहन्म्यद्य पाण्डवार्थाय दंशितः॥
en: The vast army of the illustrious Pandava (Yudhishthira) again began to fly away. Having seen the Somakas routed the Kurus gladdening the heart of the grandsire rushed to battle with great cheerfulness. (Seeing) all this, Krishna reflected;-"Clad in armour I will kill Bhishma today for the sake of the Pandavas.

sa: धनंजयशरैर्भग्नं द्रवमाणं ततस्ततः। भीमोऽप्येवं दुराधर्षो विद्रावयति मे बलम्॥
en: Routed and shattered by the arrows of Dhananjaya as my troops are, the invincible Bhishma also is slaughtering them.

sa: ततः प्रहृष्टां तां सेनामभिवीक्ष्याथ पाण्डवाः। बभूवुर्हष्टमनसो वासुदेवश्च वीर्यवान्॥
en: Seeing the (Panchala) troops in great delight, the Pandavas and the greatly effulgent Vasudeva (Krishna) were filled with joy.

sa: तथा तित्तिरिकल्माषा हया वातसमा जवे। अवहंस्तुमुले युद्धे सहदेवमुदायुधम्॥
en: Steeds of the fleetness of wind and of variegated hue, carried Sahadeva with uplifted arms to that dreadful battle.

sa: यो यो हि यतते भेत्तुं द्रोणानीकं तवाहितः। तं तमेव वरं प्राप्य सैन्धवः प्रत्यवारयत्॥
en: Every one of your enemy who tried to penetrate through Drona's array was checked by the ruler of the Sindhus in consequence of the boon the latter had obtained from Mahadeva.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा शान्तनवो निन्दन् वाक्येन पार्थिवान्। अर्जुनं द्रष्टुमिच्छामीत्यभ्यभाषत भारत॥
en: Having thus spoken, and censuring those kings with (cruel) words, Bhishma said, O Bharata I desire to see Arjuna."

sa: ततो धनंजयो राजन् वार्ष्णेयश्चापि सर्वशः॥ अवहारं शनैश्चक्रुनिहते वाहिनीपतौ।
en: O king, when the general (Shveta) was killed, Dhananjaya (Arjuna) and the Vrishni chief (Krishna) slowly withdrew their troops.

sa: अथासाद्य तु कालिन्दी प्रतिस्रोतः समागताम्। तस्यास्तीर्थं प्रचरितं प्रकामं प्रेक्ष्य राघव। तत्र यूयं प्लवं कृत्वा तरतांशुमती नदीम्॥
en: Arriving at the Kalindi running in a contrary direction, you will, O Rāghava, behold a goodly bathing place well-worn by foot-passengers. There constructing a raft, do you cross over the river who is the daughter of the Sun.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा मुनिशार्दूलं प्रहृष्टवदनस्तदा॥ पुनस्तं परिपप्रच्छ प्राञ्जलिः प्रयतो नृपः।
en: Having said this, the king with a cheerful countenance, with folded hands, again intently asked that foremost of ascetics.

sa: नाराजके जनपदे बद्धघण्टा विषाणिनः। अटन्ति राजमार्गेषु कुञ्जराः षष्ठिहायनाः॥
en: In a kingless country long-tusked elephants sixty years old, bearing bells on their necks, do not walk the high-way.

sa: भजन्त्येते यथाकाममश्वानारुह्य शीघ्रगान्। एते भ्राजन्ति संहृष्टा गजानारुह्य सादिनः॥
en: And men riding swift coursers are at their riders, riding on elephants, are also cheerfully directing their course hither.

sa: तासां तु वचनं श्रुत्वा हरिः परमकोपनः। प्रविश्य सर्वगात्राणि बभञ्ज भगवान् प्रभुः॥ ताः कन्या वायुना भग्ना विविशुनृपतेर्गृहम्। प्रविश्य च सुसम्भ्रान्ताः सलज्जाः सास्रलोचनाः॥
en: At these words of theirs, that lord and adorable one, the Air, exceedingly enraged, then entered into their bodies, and brake all their limbs. Their bodies being thus broken by Air, those damsels, exceedingly agitated and overwhelmed with shame, with tears in their eyes entered the residence of the king.

sa: जितः स्वर्गस्तव भ्रात्रा भरतेन महात्मना। वनस्थमपि तापस्ये यस्त्वामनुविधीयते॥
en: Your high-souled brother has secured heaven, since he, resorting to asceticism, is iinitating you that resident in the woods.

sa: तेषामिच्छाम्यहं गन्तुं समीपं भावितात्मनाम्। मुनानामाश्रमो येषामहं च परिचारिणी॥
en: I wish to approach those pure-souled ascetics, whom I used to wait upon, and whom these asylums belong to.

sa: स देशः श्लाघनीयश्च नातिदूरे च राघव । गोदावर्याः समीपे च मैथिली तत्र रंस्यते॥
en: And that tract is worthy of all praise, and, O Rāghava, it is not distant from here. It is in the vicinity of the Godāvarī. Mithilā's daughter shall live there agreeably.

sa: रूपयौवनदृप्तानां दक्षिणानां च मानद। नूनमप्सरसामार्य चित्तानि प्रमथिष्यसि ॥
en: O worshipful one, you shall captivate today, the hearts of the dextrous Apsarās, proud of their youth and beauty.

sa: शतहदानां लोलत्वं शस्त्राणां तीक्ष्णतां तथा। गरुडानिलयोः शैघ्यमनुगच्छन्ति योषितः॥
en: And women imitate the instability of lightning, the sharpness of weapons, and the celerity of Garuda and the wind.

sa: सुग्रीवेणेव दीनेन दीनो भूत्वा महाबलः। समानशोकः काकुत्स्थः प्रेतकार्याण्यकारयत्॥
en: And the highly powerful Käkutstha, equally aggrieved like Sugriva, being as poorly, conducted duly the obsequious ceremonies of Vali.

sa: दरीमुखश्च बलवान् यूथपोऽभ्याययौ तदा। वृतः कोटिसहस्रेण सुग्रीवं समवस्थितः॥
en: And that powerful leader of herdsDarimukha, came, sutrounded by thousands of kotis, and took up his post by Sugriva.

sa: तथैवायुधजातानि भ्रातृभ्यां कवचानि च। रथोपस्थे प्रविन्यस्य सचर्म कठिनं च यत्॥ अथो ज्वलनसंकाशं चामीकरविभूषितम्। तमारुरुहतुस्तूर्णं भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ॥
en: And then he placed in front of the car various weapons, coats of mail, a basket bound in hide and a hoe, At length the brothers Rama and Laks maņa swiftly ascended the flaming car garnished with gold.

sa: ततो नित्यानुगस्तेषां विदितात्मा महामतिः। मृदुर्दान्तश्च कान्तश्च रामे च दृढभक्तिमान्॥ सुमन्त्रस्तैर्नृपसुतैः सार्धमाश्वास्य राघवम्। अवतारयदालम्ब्य नदीं मन्दाकिनी शिवाम्॥
en: Then that magnanimous one, having a knowledge of the soul, mild, graceful, capable of controlling his senses, steady in his regard for Rāma, and ever following him, Sumantra, in company with those sons of the auspicious river, Mandakini.

sa: अथवा न गमिष्यामि पुरीं भरतपालिताम्॥ स्वर्गोऽपि हि तया हीनः शून्य एव मतो मम।
en: Blessed is my father since he is in heaven now. I shall not repair to that city protected by Bharata. Without her even the heaven itself appears to me as desolate.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे चैव रजः समभिवर्तत। उष्णतीव्रां सहस्रांशोश्छादयद् गगने प्रभाम्॥
en: Presently appeared volumes of dust, and the hot and fierce rays of the sun were hid in the sky.

sa: मृदिताश्चापिविद्धाश्च दृश्यन्ते कमलस्रजः। कामिभिर्वनिते पश्य फलानि विविधानि च॥
en: And, my wife, behold these lotus-garlands have been crushed and scattered; and the various fruits have been partaken of.

sa: इति प्रासादशृङ्गेषु प्रमदाभिर्नरोत्तमः। शुश्राव राजमार्गस्थः प्रिया वाच उदाहृताः।॥
en: That best among men heard these pleasant words from those ladies standing on the buildings and on high ways.

sa: ह्रियमाणा तु वैदेही कंचिन्नाथमपश्यती। ददर्श गिरिशृङ्गस्थान् पञ्च वानरपुङ्गवान्॥
en: Carried away (by Ravana), Vaidehi, not finding any defender, five principal monkeys stationed on the top of a hill.

sa: बहुपुष्पफले रम्ये नानाद्विजगणायुते। विचित्रशिखरे ह्यस्मिन् रतवानस्मि भामिनि ॥
en: O damsel, I take delight in this picturesque peak abounding in flowers and fruits, and frequented by various birds.

sa: विशालान् कोसलान् रम्यान् यात्वा लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः। अयोध्यामुन्मुखो धीमान् प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having passed the extensive and romantic Kosala, the intelligent elder brother of Lakşmaņa facing Ayodhyā said with joined hands.

sa: ते प्रसाद्य महात्मानं विषण्णवदनास्तदा। ऊचुः परमसंत्रस्ताः पितामहमिदं वचः॥
en: And propitiating that high-souled one, they with melancholy countenances and in exceeding agitation, spoke these words to the Grand-sire,

sa: तमृक्षाः सृमराव्याघ्राः सिंहा नानासरीसृपाः। परिवार्योपगच्छन्ति दातारं प्राणिनो यथा॥
en: As creatures gather round a giver, bears and Srimaras, tigers lions, and various reptiles, were going along, surrounding him.

sa: पूर्वां दिशं प्रतिययौ विनतो हरियूथपः॥ ताराङ्गदादिसहितः प्लवगः पवनात्मजः। अगस्त्याचरितामाशां दक्षिणां परियूथपः॥ पश्चिमां च दिशं घोरां सुषेणः प्लवगेश्वरः। प्रतस्थे हरिशार्दूलो दिशं वरुणपालिताम्॥
en: And that leader of monkey herds, Vinata, proceeded towards the estern quarter. And that monkey, Hanumān-leader of monkeyherds in company with Tārā, Angada and others, went to the South, inhabited by Agastya. And that lord of monkeys, Suşeņa, lion among monkeys, went to the terrible western quarter, protected by Varuna.

sa: राज्ञो वचनमाज्ञाय सुमन्त्रः शीघ्रविक्रमः। योजयित्वा ययौ तत्र रथमश्वरलंकृतम्॥
en: Receiving the mandate of the sovereign, Sumantra endued with fleet vigour, yoking a car adorned with horses, came there.

sa: सोऽहं गुरुवचः कुर्वन् पृथिव्यां न वसे निशाम्। तदाप्रभृति काकुत्स्थ कृता मे काश्यपस्य ह॥
en: In consonance with the words of my spiritual guide, ever since that time I have never spent three nights together on earth. Even this had been promised by me, O Kākutstha.

sa: ब्राह्मण्यं यदि मे प्राप्तं दीर्घमायुस्तथैव च॥ ॐकारोऽथ वषट्कारो देवाश्च वरयन्तु माम्। क्षत्रवेदविदां श्रेष्ठो ब्रह्मवेदविदामपि ॥ ब्रह्मपुत्रो वसिष्ठो मामेवं वदतु देवताः। यद्येवं परमः कामः कृतो यान्तु सुरर्षभाः॥
en: If Brāhmaṇa-hood has really been obtained by e together with length of days, let Omkâra and Vaşaļkāra and the Vedas crown me; and let, you gods, that foremost of those versed in Kștra Veda ad well as of those cognizant of the Brahmaveda, even Brahma's son, Vasistha, recognise me. Having granted this prime desire of mine, do you go away, you gods.

sa: एवं मया तदा राजन् प्रत्यक्षमुपलक्षितम्। पृथिवीमण्डलं सर्वं गुहामस्म्यागतस्ततः॥
en: Thus, O king, did I actually see all the world. And from that place I came to this cave.

sa: न त्वां प्रकृतयः सर्वा श्रेणीमुख्याश्च भूषिताः। अनुव्रजितुमिच्छन्ति पौरजानपदास्तथा॥
en: Why are not your subjects, citizens urbans, and leading members of society dressed and adorned, willing to follow you?

sa: भरद्वाजो महर्षिस्तं ब्रुवन्तं भरतं तदा। प्रत्युवाच महाबुद्धिरिदं वचनमर्थवित्॥
en: As Bharata was speaking thus, the great ascetic Bharadvāja gifted with high understanding and knowing interest, answered Bharata, saying.

sa: अथवा नोच्छ्वसिष्यामि संवत्सरशतान्यपि। अहं हि शोषयिष्यामि आत्मानं विजितेन्द्रियः॥
en: And I shall not breathe for an hundred years; and controlling my sense, I shall dry up my body.

sa: कोपेन च महातेजास्तपोऽपहरणे कृते। इन्द्रियैरजितै राम न लेभे शान्तिमात्मनः॥ बभूवास्य मनश्चिन्ता तपोऽपहरणे कृते। नैवं क्रोधं गमिष्यामि न च वक्ष्ये कथंचन ॥
en: O Rāma, on account of his anger, and his sense remaining still unsubdued he found no rest from deterioration of ascetic merit. And coming by decrease of ascetic merit, he thought within himself, ‘No more shall I suffer anger to exercise me, nor will I ever say anything to any.'

sa: देवायतनचैत्येषु दीनाः पक्षिगास्तथा॥ मलिनं चाश्रुपूर्णाक्षं दीनं ध्यानपरं कृशम्। सस्त्र.पुरां च पश्याम जनमुत्कण्ठितं पुरे॥
en: And in temples and Caityas birds and beasts appear dispirited. And in the city I behold men and women pale and woe-begone and emaciated and anxious, with tears filling their eyes.

sa: स खातं पितृभिर्मार्गमन्तभौमं महात्मभिः। प्रापद्यत नरश्रेष्ठ तेन राज्ञाभिचोदितः॥
en: An commanded by the monarch, he found the underground way that had been carved out by those high-souled ones.

sa: अक्षयं सुमहद्देवि प्रवृत्तं त्वद्विनाशनम्। रामं दशरथो राजा यौवराज्येऽभिषेक्ष्यति॥
en: O worshipful one, an enduring and terrible destruction is imminent to you. King Daśaratha will install;; Rama as heir-apparent.

sa: ते समीक्ष्य समायान्तं रामप्रियचिकीर्षवः। सहसोत्पतिताः सर्वे ह्यासनेभ्यः ससम्भ्रमाः॥
en: They all seeing Sumantra, ever wishing good to Rāma, approach, rose suddenly up from their seats with due respect.

sa: स तदन्तःपुरद्वारं समतीत्य जनाकुलम्। प्रविविक्तां ततः कक्ष्यामाससाद पुराणवित्॥
en: Sumantra, well versed in legends, after passing by the gateways crowded with people, reached the solitary apartment (of Rāma).

sa: एवमुक्त्वा शुभं वाक्यं जटायुस्तस्य रक्षसः। निपपात भृशं पृष्ठे दशग्रीवस्य वीर्यवान् ॥ तं गृहीत्वा नखैस्तीक्ष्णैर्विददार समन्ततः। अधिरूढो गजारोहो यथा स्याद् दुष्टावारणम्॥ विददार नखैरस्य तुण्डपृष्ठे समर्पयन्। केशांश्चोत्पाटयामास नखपक्षमुखायुधः॥
en: Addressing these moral words, the mighty Jațāyu swooped on the back of that Ten-necked Răkşasa. Like to the rider of a mad elephant, the lord of vultures began to tcar Rāvana with his sharpened claws, and that one having for his weapons his beak, talons, and wings, began to rive Rāvana's back with his beak and claws, and to uproot his hair,

sa: स तमुच्छ्रितमत्यर्थं महावेगो महाकपिः। उरसा पातयामास जीमूतमिव मारुतः॥
en: Like to Wind dispersing clouds, that mighty monkey with great velocity crushed down those up-lifted peaks with his breast.

sa: नाना चित्राः कथाश्चान्या विश्वामित्रसहायने। जानक्याश्च विवाहं च धनुषश्च विभेदनम्॥ रामरामविवादं च गुणान् दाशरथेस्तथा। तथाभिषेकं रामस्य कैकेय्या दुष्टभावताम्॥ विघातं चाभिषेकय रामस्य च विवासनम्। राज्ञः शोकं विलापं च परलोकस्य चाश्रयम् ॥ प्रकृतीनां विषादं च प्रकृतीनां विसर्जनम्। निषादाधिपसंवादं सूतोपावर्तनं तथा॥
en: And the wonderful converse he had with Visvāmitra; wedding of Janaka's daughter; and breaking the bow; the hostilities of Rāma with Rāma (Paraśurāma); and the noble qualities of Dasaratha's son: and Rama's installation; and the enmity of Kaikeyī; and the obstacle in the way of the installation; and the exile of Rāma; and the kings grief, lamentations, and departure for the other regions; and the grief of the subjects, and their dismissal (by Rāma to Ayodhyā); and the tidings of the lord of Nişādas, and the charioteer's return.

sa: चतुर्दश सहस्राणि रक्षसां भीमकर्मणाम्। हतान्येकेन रामेण खरश्च सहदूषणः॥ ऋषीणामभयं दत्तं कृतक्षेमाश्च दण्डकाः। धर्षितं च जनस्थानं रामेणाक्लिष्टकारिणा॥
en: Fourteen thousands of Raksasas of dreadful deeds, with Khara and Dūşana, have all been slain by Rāma single-handed; Rāma of untiring energy has inspired the saints with courage; the Dandakas have been benefited; and Janasthāna had been harassed.

sa: उदिते विमले सूर्ये पुष्ये चाभ्यागतेऽहनि। लग्ने कर्कटके प्राप्ते जन्म रामस्य च स्थिते॥ अभिषेकाय रामस्य द्विजेन्द्रैरुपकल्पितम्। काञ्चना जलकुम्भाश्च भद्रपीठं स्वलंकृतम्॥ रथश्च सम्यगास्तीर्णो भास्वता व्याघ्रचर्मणा। गङ्गायमुनयोः पुण्यात् संगमादाहृतं जलम्॥ याश्चान्याः सरितः पुण्या हृदाः कूपाः सरांसि च। प्राग्वहाश्चोर्ध्ववाहाश्च तिर्यग्वाहाश्च क्षीरिणः॥ ताभ्यश्चैवाहतं तोयं समुद्रेभ्यश्च सर्वशः। क्षौद्रं दधि घृतं लाजा दर्भाः सुमनसः पयः॥ अष्टौ च कन्या रुचिरा मत्तश्च वरवारणः। सजलाः क्षीरिभिश्छन्ना घटाः क
en: On the appearance of the bright Sun, on the approach of the day under the astral influence of Puşya and on the ascension of Karkata, the presiding star of Rāma's birth, they brought all articles necessary for the installation and as ordered by the best of Brāhmaṇas, namely; gold, earthen jar (for preserving water), well ornamented excellent seats, chariot with a coverlet of splendid tiger-skin, water brought from the sacred confluence of the Ganges and Yamunā, from other holy streams, lakes, wells, ponds and rivers full of water flowing in the East, over mountains, and from the North to the South; and waters brought from all the oceans, honey, curd, clarified butter, fried paddy, sacrificial grass, milk, flowers, eight unmarried girls exquisitely beautiful, a mad elephant, gold and silver

sa: इति संवदतोरेवमन्योन्यं नरसिंहयोः। आगम्य प्राञ्जलिः काले गुहो वचनमब्रवीत्।।४।
en: As those chiefs of men were thus conversing with each other, Guha appearing in time with joined hands, remarked.

sa: ततोऽन्यद् धनुरादाय रावणः क्रोधमूर्छितः। ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Thereat Rävana, almost beside himself with wrath, taking up another bow, began to shower arrows by hundreds and thousands.

sa: स राक्षसरथे पश्यञ्जानकी बाष्पलोचनाम्। अचिन्तयित्वा बाणांस्तान् राक्षसं समभिद्रवत्॥ ततोऽस्य सशरं चापं मुक्तामणिविभूषितम्। चरणाभ्यां महातेजा बभञ्ज पतगोत्तमः॥
en: Beholding Jānaki with tears in her eyes in that Raksasa's car, Jatayu, the king of birds, disregarding those arrows, darted towards Rāvana, and with his feet broke asunder his bow with the arrows, adorned with pearls and diamonds.

sa: राघवस्य विलापं च गृध्रराजनिबर्हणम्। कबन्धदर्शनं चैव पम्पायाश्चापि दर्शनम्॥
en: Rāghava's lamentations, and the death of the king of vultures; Rāma's encounter with Kabandha, and his view of Pampā.

sa: रात्रौ लङ्काप्रवेशं च एकस्यापि विचिन्तनम्। आपानभूमिगमनमवरोधस्य दर्शनम् ॥ दर्शनं रावणस्यापि पुष्पकस्य च दर्शनम्। अशोकवनिकायानं सीतायाश्चापि दर्शनम्॥
en: His entrance by night into Lankā; his ascertaining of conduct in times of helplessness; his journey to the Āpāna ground; and his sight of his car Puşpaka; his walk to the Asoka forest, and sight there of Şītā.

sa: त्वया विरहितश्चाहं त्यक्ष्ये जीवितमात्मनः। इतीव विलपन् रामः सीतादर्शनलालसः॥ न ददर्श सुदुःखार्तो राघवो जनकात्मजाम्।
en: Without you I shall renounce my own life. Being desirous of seeing Sītā, Rāma afflicted with grief began to bewail in this strain, but did not behold the daughter of Janaka.

sa: त्रातां त्वं हि नरश्रेष्ठ सर्वेषां त्वं हि भावनः॥ राजा च कृतकार्यः स्यादहं दीर्घायुरव्ययः। स्वर्गलोकमुपाश्नीयां तपस्तप्त्वा ह्यनुत्तमम्॥
en: And, O best of men, you are the protector of all, and their refuge. May the king have his desire and may I at the same time, attaining long life, and undeteriorating, gain heaven, having performed meritorious austerities!

sa: मातृभ्यो मातृकार्याणि कृत्वा परमयन्त्रितः॥ गुरूणां गुरुकार्याणि काले कालेऽन्ववैक्षत।
en: And heedfully rendering every service to his mothers, he on proper occasions observed the duties pertaining to his superiors.

sa: स सागरजलं भित्वा बभूवात्युच्छ्रितस्तदा। यथा जलधरं भित्त्वा दीमरश्मिर्दिवाकरः॥
en: Like to the Sun of bright rays rising out of the watery expanse, he uplifted himself from the Ocean.

sa: तं प्रस्रवणपृष्ठस्थं समासाद्याभिवाद्य च। आसीनं सह रामेण सुग्रीवमिदमब्रुवन्॥
en: And coming to Sugrīva seated along with Rāma behind the Fountain, and saluting the former, Susena said to Sugriva.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रूरो भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।॥ तावुवाच महाबाहुः कबन्धो दानवोत्तमः।
en: Meanwhile the wicked headless, demon, of huge arms, the foremost of Dānavas, addressed the two brothers Rāma and Lakşmaņa.

sa: सराममपि तावन्मे रथं दृष्ट्वा तदा जनः। विना रामं रथं दृष्ट्वा विदीर्येतापि सा पुरी॥ दैन्यं हि नगरी गच्छेद् दृष्ट्वा शून्यमिमं रथम्। सूतावशेषं स्वं सैन्यं हतवीरमिवाहवे।४१॥
en: Having then seen my car with Rāma on it, the hearts of the people and the palace will in all likelihood burst when they shall see it without Rāma. Surely the city will be distressed on beholding this empty car, like a host seeing car with its ro slain and the charioteer alone left in the field.

sa: ओष्ठौ परिलिहशुष्कौ नेत्रैरनिमिषैरिव। मृतभूत इवार्तस्तु रावणं समुदैक्षत ॥
en: And licking up his dried lips, with winkless eyes, (Marica) as if dead, and exceedingly distressed, eyed Ravana, steadily.

sa: विनद्य सुमहानादं श्रमेणोपरताः स्त्रियः। निर्घोषो विरतो नूनमद्य राजनिवेशने॥
en: Having bewailed aloud, by this time have the women got exhausted; and surely the king's mansion is to-day still.

sa: स्वर्गेऽपि शोकं च विवर्णतां च मया विना प्राप्स्यति वीर वाली। रम्ये नगेन्द्रस्य तटावकाशे विदेहकन्यारहितो यथा त्वम्॥
en: Even in the land of celestials, O hero, Vāli shall turn pale with grief in my separation, like to you in the picuresque dale of the Lord of mountains, separated from the daughter of the king of Videha.

sa: किमिदं भाषसे राजन् वाक्यं गररुजोपमम्। आनाययितुमक्लिष्टं पुत्रं राममिहार्हसि॥ स्थाप्य राज्ये मम सुतं कृत्वा रामं वनेचरम्। निःसपत्नां च मां कृत्वा कृतकृत्यो भविष्यसि।।२२।
en: What words, O king, do you say, comparable to poison or painful indisposition's. It behove you to summon hither your son, the energetic Rāma. Having established my son in the kingdom, and rendered Rāma a ranger of the woods and made myself rid of rivals, I shall attain my end.

sa: एवमुक्तवतस्यस्य रावणस्य शिखिप्रभे। क्रुद्धस्य हरिपर्यन्ते रक्ते नेत्रे बभूवतुः॥
en: When he had spoken thus, his yellow eyes became blood-red with rage and assumed the, semblance of flaming fire.

sa: अग्राण्यारुह्य शैलानां शिखराणि महान्त्यपि। ऊर्ध्वमुत्पात्य तरसा प्रतिगृह्णाति वीर्यवान्॥
en: Ascending the tops of mountains, Vāli possessed of prowess throws up their summits, and then again swiftly holds them.

sa: मध्यं तु समनुप्राप्य भागीरथ्यास्त्वनिन्दिता। वैदेही प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा तां नदीमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having arrived at the middle of the Bhagirathi, that blameless one, Vaidehi, with joined hands, addressed the river, saying.

sa: ततो हि यजमानस्य जोरद्भुतकर्मणः॥ गङ्गा सम्प्लावयामास यज्ञवाटं महात्मनः।
en: And Gangā flooded the sacrificial ground of the high-souled Jahnu of wonderful deeds, as he was performing a sacrifice.

sa: कच्चिदात्मसमाः शूराः श्रुतवन्तो जितेन्द्रियाः। कुलीनाश्चेङ्गितज्ञाश्च कृतास्ते तात मन्त्रिणः॥
en: And, my child, have you employed as your controlled, well-born, and understanding signs, who are like your own self?

sa: तद्वाक्यं धर्मसंयुक्तं श्रुत्वा सर्वे सभासदः। हर्षान्मुमुचुरश्रूणि रामे निहितचेतसः॥
en: Hearing words informed with those righteousness, the entire assembly with their minds intent upon Rāma, from joy shed tears.

sa: इत्युक्तः कैकेयीपुत्रः काकुत्स्थेन महात्मना। प्रगृह्य बलवद् भूयः प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।४।
en: Thus accosted by the high-souled Kākutstha, Kaikeyi's son, suppressing his grief by a strong effort, with joined hands said.

sa: तस्य देवप्रभावस्य तपसा भावितात्मनः। समीपे शरभङ्गस्य ददर्श महदद्भुतम्॥
en: And Rāma beheld a mighty wonder near that one of celestial virtue, who had purified his soul through asceticism.

sa: एवं सम्भाषमाणं तं रामहेतोपात्मजम्। प्रत्युवाच जनः सर्वः श्रीमद्वाक्यमनुत्तमम्॥
en: When the prince had spoken thus in behalf of Rāma, all those persons answered him in these excellent words.

sa: स प्रहस्याब्रवीन्मन्दं क्रोधात् तमसुरेश्वरम्। विसृज्य ताः स्त्रियः सर्वास्ताराप्रभृतिकास्तदा॥
en: Where to replied Vāli, laughing, to that wicked lord of Asuras, leaving aside all his wives, headed by Tārā.

sa: रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गं दृष्ट्वा विनिहतं पतिम्॥ उवाच तारा पिङ्गाक्षं पुत्रमङ्गदमङ्गना।
en: Beholding her husband thus slain and besmeared with blood, she spoke to her son, Angada, having coppery eyes, saying:

sa: तस्यां गतायां गहनं व्रजन्तौ वनमोजसा। आसेदतुरमित्रघ्नौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ॥
en: On her departure, proceeding quickly, the two brothers, Rāma and Lakşmaņa, the conquerors of foes, reached a dense forest.

sa: प्रजापतिसमः श्रीमान् धाता रिपुनिषूदनः। रक्षिता जीवलोकस्य धर्मस्य परिरक्षिता॥
en: Narada says-Like Prajapati himself; blessed with prosperity; protecting all; the destroyer of enemies, and protector of all living beings.

sa: बाढमित्येव गाधेयो वसिष्ठं प्रत्युवाच ह। यथाप्रियं भगवतस्तथास्तु मुनिपुङ्गव॥
en: Then Gadhi's son answered Vasistha, Very well. O potent ascetic, let that be which find favour in your sight.'

sa: भरतः खलु धर्मात्मा पितरं मातरं च मे। धर्मार्थकामसहितैर्वाक्यैराश्वासयिष्यति॥
en: But surely the virtuous Bharata will console our father and mother with words fraught with virtuc, interest and profit.

sa: तदेवमेतं त्वमनुव्रता सती पतिप्रधाना समयानुवर्तिनी। भव स्वभर्तुः सहधर्मचारिणी यशश्च धर्म च ततः समाप्स्यसि।२९।।
en: Therefore following this one, and adopting the course of chaste women, do you prove the associate in virtue of your husband, and then shall you attain both fame and religious merit.

sa: सा हृता राक्षसेन्द्रेण रावणेन दुरात्मना। मायामास्थाय विपुलां वातदुर्दिनसंकुलाम्॥
en: Sītā has been carried away by Rāvana, the lord of Rākşasas, creating a mighty illusion producing wind and showers.

sa: मुनिवेषं सहस्राक्षं विज्ञाय रघुनन्दन। मतिं चकार दुर्मेधा देवराजकुतूहलात्॥
en: Thereupon, out of curiosity, that one of perverse understanding consented to the proposals of the chief of the celestials.

sa: उपविष्टाय च तदा विश्वामित्राय धीमते। यथान्यायं मुनिवरः फलमूलमुपाहरत्॥
en: And on the intelligent Viśvāmitra having been seated, that best of ascetics properly entertained him with fruits and roots.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीन्महातेजा रामो लक्ष्मणमग्रतः। स्थितं प्राग्गामिनं धीरं याचमानं कृताञ्जलिम्॥
en: Then the highly effulgent Rāma spoke thus to that sedate Lakşmaņa, who stood praying before him with clasped hands.

sa: मतिप्रवृद्धानिलबर्हिणानाम्। प्लवङ्गमानां च गतोत्सवानां ध्रुवं रवाः सम्प्रति सम्प्रणष्टाः॥
en: Now has stopped the noise of rivers, clouds, fountains, water, the. high winds, the peacocks and the mirthless frogs.

sa: नार्हामि सम्मानमिमं प्रजानां न यौवराज्यं कुत एव राज्यम्। मेवंविधं राघव कर्म कृत्वा ॥
en: Perpetrating such an improper and irreligious act, tending to the decay of my family, I do not deserve the respect of my subjects and the heirapparentship; what of kingdom, O Rāghava.

sa: स्वलंकृताश्च पुरुषा ब्राह्मणान् पर्यवेषयन्। उपासन्ते च तानन्ये सुमृष्टमणिकुण्डलाः॥
en: Persons adorned with ornaments distributed the victuals among the Brāhmaṇas, and they were assisted by others wearing jewelled pendants.

sa: ततस्तेन महातेजा वीर्ययुक्तः कपीश्वरः। वेगेनाभिहतो वाली निपपात महीतले॥
en: Being wounded by that shaft that highly powerful chief of monkeys, gifted with prowess fell down on the earth.

sa: पराभूताश्च दैत्येन्द्रास्त्वयि क्रुद्धे महाद्युते। त्वं हि कर्ता विकर्ता च भूतानामिह सर्वशः॥ आराधयित्वा त्वां देवाः सुखमेधन्ति सर्वशः।
en: O greatly effulgent one, it was your anger that vanquished the great Daitya chiefs. You are the creator, you are the destroyer of all the creatures of this world. Adoring you, the celestials have obtained happiness and bliss.”

sa: बाहू उपनिधायान्याः पारिहार्यविभूषिताः। अंशुकानि च रम्याणि प्रमदास्तत्र शिश्यिरे॥
en: Other females, making their gay scarf-ends (for their sheets), and making their arms, their pillows, were lying down there.

sa: ततः शारद्वतः षड्भिः प्रत्यविद्ध्यद् युधिष्ठिरम्। विव्याध चाश्वान्निशितैस्तस्याष्टाभिः शिलीमुखैः॥
en: The son of Sharadvata struck Yudhishthira in return with eight arrows and his horses also with cight keen arrows.

sa: नदन्तं पाञ्चजन्यं च वृष्ण्यन्धकनिवेशने। समन्तात् पर्यवाशन्त रासभा दारुणस्वराः॥
en: When the Panchajanya was blown in their houses, asses of dissonant and awful voice brayed aloud from all sides.

sa: अशृण्वानाः पुराणानां धर्माणां परमा गतीः। उत्पथं प्रतिपत्स्यन्ते काममन्युसमीरिताः॥
en: Disregarding the Puranas and the great truths of religion, men, urged by lust and anger, will wend wrong ways.
